text: The U.S. Army swore in four senior executives with ties to technology companies Meta, Palantir and OpenAI as lieutenant colonels in 2025.

claimReview.title: US Army swore in tech executives as lieutenant colonels

text: Military veteran and Purple Heart recipient Sae Joon Park self-deported to South Korea after receiving an ultimatum from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

claimReview.title: ICE ultimatum forced Purple Heart veteran to self-deport to South Korea

text: California Gov. Gavin Newsom issued a blanket pardon for anyone arrested and charged by the LAPD for rioting and looting during the 2025 Los Angeles immigration protests.

claimReview.title: Newsom didn't issue blanket pardon for LA protest rioters and looters

text: An image showing multiple private jets parked at an airport authentically showed the aircraft of guests who traveled to billionaire Jeff Bezos' 2025 wedding in Venice, Italy.

claimReview.title: Does image show private jet traffic jam at Jeff Bezos' Venice wedding?

text: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce bought a tiny diner that let him eat on credit during his college days, converting the eatery to feed 120 homeless people every day.

claimReview.title: Travis Kelce bought tiny diner from college days to feed homeless people?

text: A photo authentically shows future U.S. first lady Melania Trump, then Melania Knauss, posing partially nude for modeling pictures on the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein's airplane.

claimReview.title: This Melania Trump photo is real, but it wasn't taken on Epstein's plane

text: A video authentically shows a cross catching on fire during a Mass service at St. Michael's Church in Dallas on June 15, 2025.

claimReview.title: Video shows cross catching fire during Mass at Dallas church?

text: Chinese scientists have developed the world's lightest "brain control" device to turn bees into remotely controlled "cyborg" drones for military surveillance and reconnaissance missions.

claimReview.title: Rumors about Chinese researchers creating bee-control device buzzing out of control

text: The FBI is investigating entertainment icon Oprah Winfrey for a "land grab" following the August 2023 Maui wildfires.

claimReview.title: FBI investigating Oprah for Maui 'land grab'?

text: A video authentically showed a U.S. Customs and Border Protection agent smashing a car window with a rifle during an arrest in Charlotte, North Carolina.

claimReview.title: Video shows CBP agent in Charlotte smashing car window with rifle during arrest

text: In 2025, Bibles sent to Oklahoma public school teachers by state Superintendent Ryan Walters included copies of the U.S. Constitution without the 11th through 27th amendments.

claimReview.title: Some Oklahoma schools received Trump-backed Bibles with outdated U.S. Constitution. Here's context

text: Videos shared in July 2025 authentically showed a dolphin saving a snow leopard lost at sea.

claimReview.title: Put rumors of dolphin saving snow leopard cub lost at sea on ice

text: A video shows the Green Party celebrating an election win in a foreign language.

claimReview.title: Campaign video shared with false claims it shows Green Party celebrating election win in Bengali – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video was posted before the election. It is a Bengali language campaign video posted by the Green Party candidate for the Mayor of Newham, Areeq Chowdhury, who also posted videos in English, Urdu and Romanian. Mr Chowdhury did not win the election.

text: A never-before-seen clip of John F. Kennedy shows him saying: “I have made it clear to the Israeli leadership that I do not support their expansionist ideas. The indigenous people of that land have rights that cannot be ignored. We must find a fair solution, not one dictated by any single group.”

claimReview.title: Is a viral clip of JFK disagreeing with Israeli policy real or AI? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence JFK said this. Media forensics experts say the video and audio were likely made using AI.

text: For the first time ever, the total welfare bill is now higher than total receipts from income tax.

claimReview.title: Welfare payments have not exceeded income tax ‘for the first time ever’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Welfare spending, which includes state pensions, has been higher than income tax in every year since at least 2013/14.

text: A map shows councils run by Reform in the UK and has been shared with the caption “so much for ‘WE’VE TAKEN OVER THE NATION!!!’”.

claimReview.title: Viral map doesn’t show all councils Reform UK controls – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This map does not include county councils now run by Reform UK, or other councils the party won control over at the 2025 local elections.

text: The World Health Organization says that hantavirus is spreading very fast across the world.

claimReview.title: WHO has not said hantavirus is spreading ‘very fast across the world’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The WHO has described the outbreak of hantavirus as a ‘cluster’ and said in a press conference that there is no sign it is the start of a larger outbreak.

text: Unemployment has risen every month that Labour have been in government.

claimReview.title: Conservative ‘Alternative King’s Speech’ repeats inaccurate claim about Labour’s unemployment record – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The number of people who are unemployed and the unemployment rate have increased overall since Labour entered government in July 2024, but both have seen some decreases within this period.

text: Newly elected Reform UK councillor George Boyd doesn’t exist.

claimReview.title: No, Reform UK did not field a ‘fake’ candidate in Norfolk – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mr Boyd is a real person.

text: Recent pictures show Nigel Farage in hospital after surgery.

claimReview.title: More fake pictures of Nigel Farage in hospital circulate online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. These images aren’t real, and there’s no evidence Mr Farage recently had a surgical procedure.

text: Hantavirus is listed as a side effect of Pfizer’s Covid-19 vaccine.

claimReview.title: Hantavirus is not listed as a side effect of Pfizer’s Covid-19 vaccine – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Hantavirus was cited in Pfizer documents as part of a list of adverse events of special interest. These are health conditions researchers monitor during vaccine trials, not side effects.

text: Tommy Robinson was pictured with the suspect in the White House Correspondent’s dinner shooting, Cole Allen.

claimReview.title: Fake picture of Tommy Robinson with White House Correspondents’ dinner shooting suspect shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image is fake, and was made using AI.

text: Bar charts show Scottish Labour ahead of the SNP in two Scottish parliamentary constituencies in Edinburgh and Glasgow.

claimReview.title: Scottish Labour bar charts in Edinburgh and Glasgow leaflets aren’t reliable projections for Holyrood election – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These bar charts don’t give a reliable picture of parties’ likely standings in the upcoming Scottish parliamentary elections. They are labelled as showing projected results based on the 2024 general election, and data from that election can’t reliably tell us about the likely outcome of the 2026 Holyrood contest.

text: A video shows Iranian missiles hitting US ships near Jask Island.

claimReview.title: Old military exercise video shared with false claims it shows Iranian missiles hitting US ships – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video is from 2016 and shows a military sinking exercise of the decommissioned USS Thach.

text: Voters should use pens not pencils to ensure fair voting.

claimReview.title: Should you take a pen to a polling station? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: People voting in UK elections can use pens or pencils, and bring their own to vote. But the Electoral Commission says there’s no need to be concerned about vote tampering if you vote in pencil, and warns using a pen carries a risk of accidentally spoiling your ballot if ink smudges or leaks.

text: Scotland is housing 10% of the UK’s asylum seekers.

claimReview.title: Are 10% of the UK’s asylum seekers being housed in Scotland? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct according to the latest figures, which show just over 6% of asylum seekers who are being supported by the UK government are housed in Scotland.

text: A video shows UK Border Force officers intercepting, securing and transferring migrants from a small boat.

claimReview.title: Footage of small boat being intercepted by Border Force is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This footage is fake. It has been created with artificial intelligence (AI).

text: There are no university tuition fees in Scotland.

claimReview.title: Are there university tuition fees in Scotland? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t quite right. While the Scottish government covers tuition fees for those ordinarily resident in Scotland taking their first full-time undergraduate degree, fees do need to be paid by some other students, such as many of those studying postgraduate courses.

text: Van and truck drivers rammed into Muslim street prayers in London and Cardiff.

claimReview.title: Fake report of van and truck drivers ramming into Muslim street prayers shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There’s no evidence of these incidents having happened, and four of the images shared with the report are of old events, and another is almost certainly AI-generated.

text: The Supreme Court has ordered Keir Starmer to resign.

claimReview.title: No, the Supreme Court has not ordered Keir Starmer to resign – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A spokesperson for the Supreme Court confirmed this isn’t true and that it doesn’t have the power to order politicians or government ministers to resign.

text: Laura Kuenssberg called for Rupert Lowe’s microphone to be cut off in a heated interview on her Sunday programme, which led to Mr Lowe walking out.

claimReview.title: False claims Laura Kuenssberg clashed with Rupert Lowe on air shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The BBC has confirmed this content is fake. The picture accompanying the post contains an AI watermark.

text: This video shows several people saying they plan to vote for Reform UK, and one saying he will vote for Restore.

claimReview.title: Video of voters on the street is AI-generated – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video is fake. The footage does not show real people and has been AI-generated.

text: A video shows a BBC News report about a stolen painting by Paul Cézanne appearing in footage from Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

claimReview.title: Fake BBC News report about stolen Cézanne painting appearing in Zelenskyy video circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t a real report from the BBC and the clip of President Zelenskyy has been edited to include the stolen Cézanne painting.

text: A recently filmed video shows a crowded small boat crossing the English Channel.

claimReview.title: Video of migrant small boat crossing English Channel is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video is fake. It has been created with AI.

text: Muslims who use their living areas as a place of worship are exempt from paying council tax.

claimReview.title: Misleading claim about ‘council tax exemption’ for Muslims recirculates on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no council tax exemption for domestic property owners who claim their home, or part of it, is used for religious purposes, regardless of their religion.

text: Videos show Donald Trump criticising Sadiq Khan for “turning London into a s**tshow” and saying he “needs a Tomahawk [missile] up his a**”.

claimReview.title: Video of Donald Trump altered to include fake audio of him criticising Sadiq Khan – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The audio in these clips is fake. We traced the footage to an old video of President Trump announcing ‘gold cards’ as a path to citizenship in the US, the audio of which has been altered. He makes no mention of Sadiq Khan in the original clip.

text: Rupert Lowe was named one of Time magazine’s 100 most influential people of 2026.

claimReview.title: Rupert Lowe doesn’t appear on Time magazine’s 2026 list of the 100 most influential people – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mr Lowe does not appear on this list.

text: Boots is giving away a mini perfume set to people who complete a customer feedback survey.

claimReview.title: False claims about Boots mini perfume set giveaway is repeated again – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine offer from Boots.

claimReview.title: More fake claims about Boots ‘mini-perfume set’ giveaway shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine offer from Boots.

text: A video shows a US Black Hawk helicopter shot down by Iran.

claimReview.title: Video shows 2020 incident in Syria, not a recent Iranian attack on a US Black Hawk helicopter – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video is from Syria in 2020.

text: The Daily Mail published an article headlined “Members think Keir Starmer shouldn’t resign”.

claimReview.title: Fake ‘Daily Mail’ report on Labour members’ views of Keir Starmer shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is fake. The Daily Mail published no such article, although it contains details of a real survey of Labour members.

text: In a video, the Mayor of Rotherham says in Arabic that Britain can only be great again by implementing Sharia law, and demands the expulsion of all non-Muslims, including British citizens.

claimReview.title: Video doesn’t show mayor calling for Sharia law and ‘expulsion’ of non-Muslims from Britain – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Councillor Rukhsana Ismail does not make these comments in the footage being shared. She is actually saying a blessing in Arabic, as part of a longer video message—in which she also speaks in English—about the month of Ramadan.

text: Images shared by Katie Hopkins show her in hospital.

claimReview.title: Fake pictures of Katie Hopkins in hospital shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These pictures are fake. They haven’t been shared by the media personality, and contain an invisible watermark identifying it as AI generated content.

text: Zia Yusuf was named in Time magazine’s list of the 100 most influential people of 2026.

claimReview.title: Zia Yusuf was not included on Time magazine’s 2026 list of 100 most influential people – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mr Yusuf does not appear on this list.

text: A video shows more than 500 people gathering in Birmingham to protest against the government.

claimReview.title: Video claiming to show 500-strong anti-government protest in Birmingham is AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This footage is not genuine; it has been generated using artificial intelligence (AI).

text: Aldi is offering cheap boxes of leftover yarn to anyone who has lived in the UK five years and who fills out a survey.

claimReview.title: Fake Aldi posts claiming to offer cheap craft boxes shared on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Aldi has confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: Reform UK edited the announcement of its Harrow candidate Dr Savitha Prakash after initially posting a picture of her wearing a headscarf.

claimReview.title: No evidence for online claims Reform edited its Harrow candidate announcement after ‘backlash’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is absolutely no evidence this is true. Both Reform UK and Dr Prakash say the headscarf image is fake and they didn’t publish it.

text: Tesco is offering a Pokemon trading card game package for a reduced price to people who fill in a survey.

claimReview.title: Facebook post offering cut-price deals on Pokemon trading cards is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Tesco has confirmed this isn’t a genuine offer.

text: Videos show large groups of Muslims praying in the middle of London streets.

claimReview.title: Fake AI videos depict large crowds of Muslims praying in London streets – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These videos are fake. They have been generated with artificial intelligence (AI).

text: We don’t know how many asylum seekers have been dispersed across Wales.

claimReview.title: How many asylum seekers are being housed in Wales? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. The government publishes quarterly figures showing the number of asylum seekers being supported by each local authority in Wales. As of December 2025, 3,353 asylum seekers were being supported in Wales, most of whom were in Cardiff.

text: Videos show overturned dinghies in the English Channel, including one where over 100 people supposedly died.

claimReview.title: AI-generated videos of upturned dinghies in the English Channel circulate online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These videos aren’t real and were made using artificial intelligence. There are no reports of 100 people dying during a recent attempt to cross the English Channel in a small boat.

text: An image shows people cleaning up blood-soaked streets in Iran.

claimReview.title: Fake image of people cleaning blood off street in Iran shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real and was very likely made with artificial intelligence.

text: Reform UK has not said it would keep free prescriptions in Wales.

claimReview.title: Welsh Labour makes inaccurate claim about Reform UK’s prescriptions stance – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Reform UK’s Welsh manifesto didn’t mention prescriptions, but the party has said elsewhere it would keep them free in Wales.

text: Videos show the Australian border force on ships intercepting small boats, including one where an official shoots near people in a dinghy.

claimReview.title: AI-generated videos of heavily armed Australian border force at sea shared thousands of times – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These videos aren’t real and were made using artificial intelligence.

text: 800,000 Scottish people are currently waiting for NHS treatment.

claimReview.title: Are 800,000 Scottish people waiting for NHS treatment? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is an unreliable figure. It is the total number of waits for new outpatient, inpatient and day case appointments, and for eight key diagnostic tests. It is not the number of individuals who are on these waiting lists.

text: An image shows Reform UK MP Sarah Pochin with Asian supporters.

claimReview.title: Fake AI-edited image of Reform UK MP Sarah Pochin circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image has been edited to change the supporters standing with her in the original photo posted by Ms Pochin. The edited image contains a SynthID watermark, indicating it was changed using Google AI tools.

text: A video shows an interview with two women wearing niqabs on Brighton beach who say that the UK has too many dogs, and people should avoid bringing dogs to beaches where Muslims relax.

claimReview.title: Video of Muslim women calling for Brighton beach to be dog-free is AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video is fake. It has been made with artificial intelligence.

text: A mob of 460 masked rioters recently stormed migrant hotels in Rotherham and Tamworth.

claimReview.title: False claims about rioters recently storming migrant hotels in Rotherham and Tamworth circulate online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. South Yorkshire and Staffordshire police forces confirmed this didn’t happen.

text: Theft from a person has tripled in London since Sadiq Khan became mayor.

claimReview.title: Police data for London doesn’t show knife crime is up 72% in a year – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Correct. The number of police-recorded theft from the person offences in London roughly tripled between the year ending March 2016 and the year ending March 2025.

text: Shoplifting in London is up 38% on the previous year.

claimReview.title: Police data for London doesn’t show knife crime is up 72% in a year – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is broadly correct according to police-recorded crime figures for the year ending June 2025, but more recent figures for the year ending September 2025 show a 19% increase.

text: Knife crime in London is up 72% in a year.

claimReview.title: Police data for London doesn’t show knife crime is up 72% in a year – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not correct, according to police statistics on knife-enabled crime, and we’ve not found any data to support it. The number of serious knife crime offences recorded by police forces in London fell by 11% in the year to September 2025.

text: Videos and stills show an Iranian attack on a power plant in Haifa, Israel.

claimReview.title: Old footage from China shared with false claims it shows attack on Israeli power plant – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This imagery shows a fire drill in China in 2015.

text: One in six young people in Wales are unemployed.

claimReview.title: Are one in six young people in Wales unemployed? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t quite right. Although the youth unemployment rate in Wales is 16.3%, roughly one in six, this is only the percentage of ‘economically active’ 16-24 year olds who are unemployed. As a proportion of all 16-24 year olds in Wales, it’s more like one in ten.

text: An image shows a destroyed US base in Kuwait.

claimReview.title: Fake photo of damaged US base in Kuwait shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image is fake. It doesn’t correspond to genuine satellite imagery of US military bases in Kuwait, and contains a SynthID watermark, indicating it was generated using Google's AI tools.

text: People can claim a pallet of garden soil from B&Q for £10 by filling out a survey.

claimReview.title: Fake ‘B&Q’ £10 garden soil offer circulating on social media – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A spokesperson for B&Q has confirmed this is not a genuine deal from the retailer.

text: Liz Truss claimed an underground transgender mafia was responsible for the theft of a large shipment of KitKats in March.

claimReview.title: Satirical post about Liz Truss blaming ‘transgender mafia’ for Italian chocolate heist shared as genuine – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This post appears to have originally been shared as satire. There’s no evidence she ever said this.

text: In 2003 Keir Starmer won the case that gave illegal migrants access to UK benefits.

claimReview.title: Many asylum seekers received support prior to 2003 court case involving Keir Starmer – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. Eligible asylum seekers could access accommodation and financial support from the government before the 2003 case involving Mr Starmer, which specifically concerned whether asylum seekers who didn't claim asylum as soon as they entered the UK could also get this help.

claimReview.title: Misleading claim about Keir Starmer’s role in giving ‘illegal migrants’ access to benefits recirculates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. Mr Starmer was involved in a 2003 court case that specifically concerned whether asylum seekers who didn't claim asylum as soon as they entered the UK could get help from the government in the form of accommodation or financial support. Most asylum seekers could already receive accommodation and financial support before this case.

text: Tesco is giving away free Easter hampers to Facebook users who like and comment on a post.

claimReview.title: Facebook post suggesting Tesco is giving away free Easter hampers is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: A Tesco spokesperson has confirmed this is not a genuine offer affiliated with the retailer.

text: The UK’s youth unemployment rate is the highest in Europe.

claimReview.title: Express corrects claim about UK’s youth unemployment – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. The UK’s youth unemployment rate was higher than the EU’s average in Q3 2025, but some individual European countries had higher youth unemployment rates.

claimReview.title: UK youth unemployment is higher than the EU average, but not the ‘highest in Europe’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. While the UK’s youth unemployment rate was higher than the EU average in the third quarter of 2025, several individual European countries had higher rates.

text: An image shows a human chain in Iran, around a building which appears to be the Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant.

claimReview.title: Fake picture of human chain around Iranian power plant circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real and was made using artificial intelligence.

text: A video compilation shows destruction in Tel Aviv, Israel.

claimReview.title: Old videos of Gaza and Turkey earthquake shared with false claims they show destruction in Tel Aviv – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Of the ten videos, this compilation features at least five old clips from Gaza and two from the aftermath of the 2023 earthquake in Turkey.

text: An image showing the moon's Orientale Basin with the Earth in the background was photographed by astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft during the Artemis II mission.

claimReview.title: ‘Photo from Artemis II’ of moon crater with Earth in background is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The image is fake and almost certainly generated by artificial intelligence. It features a Gemini AI watermark and doesn’t match the geographical features seen in real photos of the impact crater.

text: The US was not a signatory to the Geneva Convention.

claimReview.title: Sky News corrects report about the US and the Geneva Conventions – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The US signed and ratified the four Conventions of 1949 and Protocol III of 2005. It did not ratify Protocols I and II of 1977, but did sign them.

text: A picture shows Earth as captured from the window of the Orion spacecraft during the Artemis II mission.

claimReview.title: Fake image of Earth from Artemis II mission shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image is fake and was almost certainly created using AI. It contains Google AI’s SynthID watermark, and does not match any of the genuine images released by NASA from the mission. The capsule window depicted has five sides, unlike the four-sided windows on the real Orion capsule.

text: A video shows that an American tanker, which attempted to transit the Strait of Hormuz, is now in the custody of Iran.

claimReview.title: Video showing Iranian soldiers boarding tanker is from 2019 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The footage is actually from July 2019 and depicts Iranian forces seizing a British-flagged vessel, the Stena Impero. There have been no verified reports of an American-flagged tanker being seized by Iran in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: The Duke of Cornwall hotel in Plymouth has been confirmed as an asylum hotel.

claimReview.title: False rumour spreads on social media about Plymouth hotel housing asylum seekers – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Plymouth City Council has said that no asylum seekers are being housed in hotels in Plymouth and no hotels in the city are being prepped for this purpose. The hotel says there is “no truth to the rumours”.

text: A picture shows Cadbury is selling a celebratory chocolate box that says “Happy Eid Mubarak” written inside.

claimReview.title: ‘Eid Mubarak’ chocolate box is not being sold by Cadbury – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: A Cadbury spokesperson confirmed the box is not a genuine Cadbury product. The box pictured is being sold on eBay by an independent gift seller.

text: One in six Scots are stuck on an NHS waiting list.

claimReview.title: Labour MP’s claim that one in six Scots are ‘stuck on an NHS waiting list’ is not reliable – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This figure isn’t reliable, as it may double-count patients waiting for multiple things. Public Health Scotland estimates 578,804 individuals in Scotland—roughly one in ten—were waiting for at least one new outpatient, inpatient or day case appointment in February, though this figure is likely not to count all those waiting for NHS appointments.

text: Katie Hopkins accused Muslim MPs of shameful political interference in the House of Commons.

claimReview.title: Katie Hopkins didn’t confront Muslim MPs in the House of Commons – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no record of this happening in Hansard and images supposedly showing this were generated with artificial intelligence.

text: Cadbury is offering Dairy Milk boxes for £10 for people who complete a form.

claimReview.title: Post promoting Cadbury Dairy Milk box deal is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Cadbury’s parent company, Mondelez, confirmed it’s not a real offer from the chocolate retailer.

text: A video shows clashes at Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv, with people shouting that they want tickets and flights to leave Israel.

claimReview.title: Video of 2025 cinema brawl shared with false claims it shows clashes at Tel Aviv airport – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This footage is actually from July 2025 and shows an incident at a cinema in Jerusalem where objects were thrown at staff.

text: Cadbury doesn’t use the word ‘Easter’ on its eggs.

claimReview.title: UK Cadbury chocolate eggs still say ‘Easter’ on them – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Cadbury continues to use the word ‘Easter’ on its Easter shell eggs.

text: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer posted a statement on X saying that American forces must withdraw from UK airbases within 48 hours and pay historic rent if the United States ends its commitment to NATO.

claimReview.title: Fake Keir Starmer post about US leaving NATO circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The image of the post is fabricated and originally came from a satirical social media account. No such statement has been published on Keir Starmer's genuine X account or made publicly by him.

text: A video shows Tel Aviv on fire.

claimReview.title: Video of 2022 fire in Saudi Arabia shared with false claims it shows Tel Aviv – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video was actually filmed in 2022 and shows a fire at a petroleum storage site in Saudi Arabia.

text: Nigel Farage posted an edited photo of a £5 note with Donald Trump on it on X saying: “The Bank of England is replacing Winston Churchill with a picture of a beaver on our bank notes. When I'm Prime Minister I will only have patriots and great friends of Britain on the currency.”

claimReview.title: Fake Farage X post about Trump on £5 notes circulates – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mr Farage’s real post about Winston Churchill being replaced has been edited to include a fake quote about “patriots and great friends of Britain” and the image of  President Trump’s face on a £5 note.

text: Footage shows Dubai’s international airport in flames.

claimReview.title: Old footage of market fire shared with false claims it shows Dubai airport in flames – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The video is old and actually depicts a fire that broke out at a market in Ajman, in the UAE, in August 2020.

text: In this Parliament, the government will spend £270 billion more on defence than it would otherwise have done.

claimReview.title: Defence spending is not set to get an extra £270 billion – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. This figure refers to the Ministry of Defence’s total projected spend between 2025/26 and 2028/29, and is not how much spending will increase by.

text: An image shows a recent attack on Jewish ambulances in London.

claimReview.title: Fake image of Jewish charity ambulances on fire shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Although this incident happened, this image is fake and was made with AI.

text: Footage shows a missile strike on the King Fahd bridge linking Bahrain and Saudi Arabia.

claimReview.title: Footage doesn’t show attack on the King Fahd causeway – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This footage is from 2022 and shows an explosion on the Kerch bridge, which links Russia and Crimea.

text: A video shows motorists in the UK facing long queues at fuel stations.

claimReview.title: Video shows queue for fuel in Spain, not UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video was filmed in Seville in Spain.

text: Keir Starmer said the UK may need to go into lockdown as early as May if meningitis cases continue to escalate.

claimReview.title: Keir Starmer didn’t say the UK ‘may need to go into lockdown’ if meningitis cases keep rising – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Number 10 confirmed Mr Starmer did not make these comments, which appear to have originated from a satirical Facebook page.

text: An image shows the aftermath of an Iranian hypersonic missile bringing down a US-Israeli linked spy satellite.

claimReview.title: Fake crash picture shared with false claims it shows satellite brought down by Iranian missile – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The image was taken from an AI-generated video posted in December, without any claims it was real. There have been no genuine reports of any satellite being brought down by Iran.

text: The Maldives has recently cut all ties with Israel and banned all Israeli products.

claimReview.title: The Maldives cut diplomatic relations with Israel in 1974, not recently – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. The Maldives actually cut diplomatic ties with Israel in 1974, and imposed a ban on the import and sale ​of all goods ​manufactured in ⁠Israel in 2014. The ​country also banned ⁠entry for Israeli passport holders in 2025, before the current conflict between the US, Israel and Iran.

text: The Prime Minister said energy bills will be capped to the end of June, saving the average household £170.

claimReview.title: BBC corrects misreported energy bills figure – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Sir Keir Starmer actually said energy bills would be cut by £117 for the average household.

text: A video shows an Iranian missile that landed in Tel Aviv and failed to explode, but subsequently detonated as firefighters approached it.

claimReview.title: Video shows US warehouse explosion not delayed missile detonation in Israel – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The footage is actually from June 2016, and shows explosions during a warehouse fire in Maywood, California, which occurred after firefighters sprayed water on burning magnesium.

text: The government isn’t spending more money on defence.

claimReview.title: Is the UK’s defence spending increasing? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. The Ministry of Defence’s budget for 2025/26 is 3.2% higher than the previous year in cash terms, and also slightly higher in real terms according to the National Audit Office. Its budget is set to increase further between 2025/26 and 2028/29, by an average of 3.8% a year in real terms.

text: Labour is delivering “the biggest boost to defence spending since the Cold War, £270 billion over the course of this Parliament”.

claimReview.title: Is the UK’s defence spending increasing? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t clear and needs context. This £270 billion figure is the Ministry of Defence’s total projected spend between 2025/26 and 2028/29, not how much spending will increase by.

text: A picture shows Soham murderer Ian Huntley in hospital after he was attacked in prison.

claimReview.title: Viral image of Ian Huntley in hospital is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real and was made using artificial intelligence.

text: A video shows a fight at Birmingham City Council after a councillor was seen eating during Ramadan.

claimReview.title: Video supposedly showing fight at Birmingham City Council was actually filmed in Pakistan – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video actually shows an altercation between lawyers at Lahore High Court in Pakistan. There’ve been no reports of any such incident at Birmingham City Council.

text: A video shows the Netanyahu family home on fire after an Iranian missile strike, which killed Iddo Netanyahu, the prime minister's brother.

claimReview.title: Footage of US fire falsely claimed to show Netanyahu home after Iranian missile strike – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video is not from the Middle East conflict but of a house fire in New Jersey in the United States. There is no evidence that Benjamin Netanyahu’s brother has been killed, and the Israel Defense Forces says this claim is incorrect.

text: The government is cutting defence spending by £2.6 billion from the Ministry of Defence budget this year.

claimReview.title: Is the UK’s defence spending increasing? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is potentially misleading. This is the 2025/26 overspend which the Ministry of Defence was reportedly forecasting last summer. But the overall MoD budget is increasing.

text: A video shows Peter Mandelson wearing a white dressing gown while being escorted from his home into a car by police.

claimReview.title: Real footage of Mandelson arrest edited to show him in dressing gown – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This clip has been edited. Lord Mandelson was actually wearing clothes when he was arrested.

text: Footage shows a recent Iranian strike on a building in Bahrain housing US officers.

claimReview.title: Footage of Russian attack on Kyiv shared with false claims it shows Iranian drone strike on Bahrain – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The clip actually shows a Russian strike on Kyiv in January.

text: An image shows that Iran has shot down an American B-2 bomber and captured the entire crew.

claimReview.title: Image showing US B-2 supposedly ‘shot down’ by Iran is fake – Full Fact

text: Pictures show the former Prime Minister Rishi Sunak in hospital recovering from a medical procedure.

claimReview.title: Pictures of Rishi Sunak in a hospital bed are fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These pictures aren’t real. Mr Sunak’s office has confirmed the posts aren’t factual.

text: Images show US soldiers captured in Iran.

claimReview.title: Viral images of ‘US soldiers captured in Iran’ are AI-generated – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These images are fake. They contain Gemini AI, and SynthID invisible watermarks and visual inconsistencies which mean they are almost certainly AI-generated.

text: A clip shows a US B-2 Spirit stealth bomber plane flying past a US ship in the Persian Gulf.

claimReview.title: B-2 stealth bomber flypast video is digital creation – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video isn’t real and was digitally created, although these planes have been deployed in the recent US air campaign against Iran.

text: An image shows the funeral of Iranian schoolchildren after they were killed in a missile strike.

claimReview.title: Fake image of Iranian children’s funeral shared online by MP – Full Fact

text: The mayor of New York Zohran Mamdani said the “UK has lost its moral compass” at an event attended by Keir Starmer, and in return the PM banned him from Britain.

claimReview.title: NYC mayor not banned from UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence Mr Mamdani said this and the audio in the video claiming this has almost definitely been made using artificial intelligence. Mr Mamdani has not been banned from Britain.

text: Cyprus is a NATO country.

claimReview.title: David Lammy incorrectly claims Cyprus is ‘a NATO country’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Cyprus is not a member of NATO.

text: Type 45 destroyers cannot take out incoming missiles.

claimReview.title: Type 45 destroyers such as HMS Dragon can shoot down incoming missiles – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Type 45 destroyers are equipped to shoot down missiles, though work to modernise air defence systems is ongoing.

text: A video shows an Iranian missile attack on Dubai.

claimReview.title: Missile strikes video does not show recent attack on Dubai – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video is from at least 2024 and doesn’t show recent strikes on Dubai.

text: A picture shows the USS Abraham Lincoln on fire after being hit by Iranian missiles.

claimReview.title: AI image of the USS Abraham Lincoln on fire shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This image isn’t real and was made using Google AI tools.

text: Inflation has fallen.

claimReview.title: Is inflation up or down under Labour? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: It’s true that the CPI measure of inflation has fallen in recent months, but it’s still higher than it was when Labour came to power.

text: A video of a burning skyscraper shows the “CIA headquarters in Dubai” on fire following a recent attack by Iran.

claimReview.title: Footage of 2015 fire shared with false claims it shows Iran attacking Dubai – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The footage shows an October 2015 fire at an apartment building in Sharjah, a neighboring city to Dubai in the UAE.

text: A video of a large fireball and smoke shows the aftermath of a drone attack on the US embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

claimReview.title: Video of blaze doesn’t show aftermath of drone attack on US embassy in Saudi Arabia – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The footage predates the attack and has been online since at least 6 February.

text: A video shows an American airbase burnt to ashes in Saudi Arabia by an Iranian missile attack.

claimReview.title: Video does not show American airbase ablaze after Iranian strike in Saudi Arabia – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video shows the aftermath of an Israeli airstrike on the port of Hudaydah in Yemen from July 2024.

text: A video shows people evacuating an Israeli plane which was targeted at Ben Gurion airport shortly before takeoff.

claimReview.title: Video showing plane evacuation was filmed in Denver, not Israel – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: That’s not what the video shows. The clip was filmed in Denver in July 2025.

text: JD Sports is offering Nike trainers for £3 to people who complete a questionnaire.

claimReview.title: JD Sports is not offering Nike trainers for £3 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a real JD Sports offer.

text: Youth unemployment is the highest in Europe.

claimReview.title: Mel Stride repeats inaccurate claim about youth unemployment – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The youth unemployment rate in the UK is higher than the EU average, but it’s higher in other European countries.

text: A video shows explosions in Tel Aviv.

claimReview.title: Video shows 2015 explosions in China, not Tel Aviv – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video shows explosions that took place in Tianjin, China, in 2015.

text: The home secretary Shabana Mahmood took part in a minute’s silence to mark the death of Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei.

claimReview.title: The home secretary did not take part in a minute’s silence for Ayatollah Khamenei – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The Home Office has confirmed this didn’t happen. The picture shared with the claims is unrelated and over a year old.

text: An image shows Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei lying partially buried in rubble after being killed in a strike on Iran by the US and Israel.

claimReview.title: Fake image showing Ayatollah Ali Khamenei buried in rubble circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image is fake. It has been made or edited using Google AI tools, as evidenced by a SynthID watermark and several visual inconsistencies.

text: An image shows the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, UAE, on fire.

claimReview.title: Fake image of burning Burj Khalifa circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image is fake and was created or altered using AI.

text: Sir Keir Starmer was arrested in January 2026.

claimReview.title: The Prime Minister hasn’t been arrested – Full Fact

text: Toby Carvery is giving away a hamper of goodies to people who comment on and like a Facebook post.

claimReview.title: Post offering free Toby Carvery hamper is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This isn’t a genuine Toby Carvery offer.

text: An image shows Lord Peter Mandelson in handcuffs being walked down a corridor by uniformed police.

claimReview.title: Fake image of Mandelson in handcuffs shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is fake. It’s not a real picture, and is almost certainly an AI-creation. The Metropolitan Police confirmed it did not release it.

text: Rupert Lowe is demanding Keir Starmer surrender £95 million in profits he claims were generated through connections to NHS reform legislation.

claimReview.title: Posts falsely claim Rupert Lowe has demanded the PM surrenders ‘profits’ linked to ‘NHS reform legislation’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. We’ve found no record of Mr Lowe making any such demand and no evidence that the claims about Mr Starmer are in any way based in fact.

text: To celebrate “National Potato Day” Toby Carvery is giving away free carveries for two to those who like and comment ‘spud’ on a Facebook post.

claimReview.title: No, Toby Carvery is not giving away a free carvery to celebrate ‘National Potato Day’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This isn’t a genuine Toby Carvery offer.

text: Youth unemployment is at its highest ever.

claimReview.title: Youth unemployment is not at its ‘highest ever’ levels – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. While both the unemployment rate and the number of unemployed 16-24 year olds reached their highest levels in a decade in December 2025, these figures were consistently higher than they are now between late 2008 and early 2015.

text: Prince William publicly challenged Sadiq Khan about London’s priorities, including veterans and working class families supposedly being pushed out of the city.

claimReview.title: Prince William has not challenged Sadiq Khan over London’s priorities – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is fake. No such clash occurred between the Prince of Wales and the Mayor of London. Prince William has not made these comments about the capital.

text: A picture shows a Cadbury ‘Eid egg’.

claimReview.title: No, Cadbury isn’t selling an ‘Eid egg’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mondelēz International, the company that owns Cadbury, confirmed this picture does not show a real Cadbury product.

text: Aldi is offering free food boxes worth £40 to users who like and comment on a post.

claimReview.title: Aldi isn’t offering a ‘free food box’ to users who engage with Facebook posts – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Aldi has confirmed it’s not associated with these posts.

text: A new poll suggests there is just one point between Labour and Reform UK in Gorton and Denton.

claimReview.title: Labour by-election bar chart fails to show poll put them level with the Greens – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is missing important context. While the figures for Labour and Reform are correct, the bar chart accompanying this claim does not include the Green Party, which was level with Labour in the poll in question. The results for all three parties were within the poll’s margin of error.

text: A picture shows Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor’s police mugshot taken after he was arrested.

claimReview.title: Fake Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor mugshot circulates following arrest – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is a fake image, as police have confirmed, and very probably AI-generated. His mugshot, if one was taken, has not been made public by Thames Valley Police.

text: Angela Rayner threatened to embarrass Suella Braverman in the House of Commons

claimReview.title: Facebook post shares fake Angela Rayner and Suella Braverman quotes – Full Fact

text: Videos show snow turning black and not dripping water when held above a lighter, which is evidence that it is chem snow laced with toxic chemtrails.

claimReview.title: Videos showing ‘burning’ snow do not prove it is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The black marks are soot deposited by incomplete combustion of the lighter fuel. The snow does not drip immediately because it absorbs the meltwater or turns directly into vapour.

text: 350 “illegal boat migrants” live in Gorton and Denton.

claimReview.title: Are 350 ‘illegal boat migrants’ living in Gorton and Denton? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: It is not possible to substantiate this assertion, which is presented as fact. It’s a broad estimate based on the number of asylum seekers receiving accommodation support in each local authority, and assumes these people are spread evenly across electoral wards. We don’t know how many asylum seekers, or people who arrived via small boat crossing, are actually living in the constituency.

text: Three images show Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor being arrested by uniformed police officers.

claimReview.title: AI-generated pictures of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor’s arrest shared online – Full Fact

text: Images show Jeffrey Epstein recently spotted in Israel.

claimReview.title: Old photos of Jeffrey Epstein edited to look like he was recently spotted in Israel – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. These are old images of Epstein that have been edited to make him look older. Epstein died in 2019.

text: One million people living in Britain don’t speak any English at all.

claimReview.title: How many people in Britain don’t speak English? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not correct according to the 2021 Census, which is the latest reliable data we know of and what Mr Farage appears to have been referring to. In 2021 the correct figure for England and Wales was 161,000. It may have risen since but is very unlikely to be as high as a million.

text: Four million people living in Britain don’t speak very good English.

claimReview.title: How many people in Britain don’t speak English? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t what the 2021 Census said. It found 880,000 in England and Wales could not speak English well, in addition to 161,000 who could not speak it at all. Some 4.1 million people said they could speak English “well” or “very well” but not as their main language.

text: Pictures shared in 2026 show Nigel Farage in hospital after undergoing surgery.

claimReview.title: Pictures showing Nigel Farage in hospital recovering from surgery are fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. These pictures aren’t real, and there’s no record of Mr Farage recently having a surgical procedure. Reform UK also told us the images are fake.

text: A picture shows Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer and his former chief of staff Morgan McSweeney in a group embrace with Lord Peter Mandelson.

claimReview.title: Picture of Keir Starmer hugging Lord Mandelson and Morgan McSweeney isn’t real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real and was almost certainly created using AI.

text: 75% of England's mayors are Muslim.

claimReview.title: No evidence 75% of England’s mayors are Muslim – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We could only find evidence that three of the country’s 27 current directly elected mayors are Muslim. There is no official list of all the country’s civic mayors, but we’ve seen no evidence to suggest as many as 75% are Muslim.

text: An image shows Jeffrey Epstein alive and walking down a street in Tel Aviv, Israel.

claimReview.title: AI-generated image of Jeffrey Epstein ‘alive in Tel Aviv’ circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This image isn’t real and was made using artificial intelligence. Jeffrey Epstein is dead.

text: Asylum seeker benefits cost the UK £60 million per year, equivalent to £2 per year per taxpayer.

claimReview.title: This comparison of asylum support, benefit fraud and tax avoidance costs is still wrong – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The government spent approximately £4 billion on asylum support in 2024/25, equivalent to about £105 per taxpayer.

text: A picture shows 18 of the country’s Muslims mayors.

claimReview.title: No evidence 75% of England’s mayors are Muslim – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Although all of the 18 people pictured identify as Muslim, just five of them are currently still mayors. These mayors are also a mixture of directly elected and civic mayors.

text: Sir Keir Starmer is the “most unpopular” prime minister in history, or since modern polling began.

claimReview.title: Is Sir Keir Starmer the ‘most unpopular’ PM in recent times? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There are various different ways pollsters measure prime ministerial popularity. While Ipsos polling shows Mr Starmer has the lowest satisfaction level of any PM since it started asking the question in the 1970s, some other polls suggest fewer people approved of or favoured Liz Truss.

text: Reform UK Photoshopped the party’s placards into a photo of a house in Gorton and Denton.

claimReview.title: No, Reform UK did not edit an image of a house in Gorton and Denton – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. These claims are based on what seems to be an edited image of a real picture shared by Reform UK’s candidate Matt Goodwin.

text: A video shows Iranian bunker buster bombs in full action.

claimReview.title: Bunker busting bomb video shows US weapons test – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t what this footage depicts. It was shared in June last year by the US Air Force, showing testing of a bunker-busting munition in December 2020.

text: A video shows Iran launching missiles from beneath the sea.

claimReview.title: Old video of Russian submarine test shared with false claim it shows Iran launching missiles – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video was posted by the Russian Ministry of Defense in 2018 and shows a Russian submarine testing intercontinental ballistic missiles.

text: A poll shows only Labour can beat Reform UK in the upcoming Gorton and Denton by-election.

claimReview.title: Poll quoted in Labour by-election ad doesn’t reliably show it’s the only party which can beat Reform – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The poll has a very small sample size, with the figures in the bar chart based on just 62 respondents. Experts say the poll can’t reliably show how support for the main parties compares.

text: Sunbeds are as dangerous as smoking.

claimReview.title: Government publishes misleading information about the dangers of sunbeds – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. The WHO has classed both sunbeds and smoking as cancer-causing hazards, but that doesn’t mean they’re equally risky. Independent experts have told us that smoking is much more likely to cause harm.

text: The government has recruited 3,000 more GPs into general practice.

claimReview.title: How many more GPs has the government recruited? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This figure is based on a headcount of GPs recruited through a specific scheme, not the overall net increase in GPs working for the NHS. There were just over 1,300 more fully qualified FTE GPs working for the NHS in September 2025 compared to the same time the previous year.

text: A photo shows Jeffrey Epstein and Nigel Farage with their arms around each other.

claimReview.title: No evidence viral image of Epstein and Farage is real - here’s why experts say it’s probably AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence this is a real image. Reform UK has said it is “completely fake”, and experts say there are a number of details which suggest it was probably created with AI.

text: Images show Zohran Mamdani as a child photographed with Jeffrey Epstein.

claimReview.title: Pictures of a young Zohran Mamdani with Jeffrey Epstein aren’t real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These images aren’t real and were made using artificial intelligence.

text: A video shows new public bins in Sheffield which require you to tap your card to pay to access them.

claimReview.title: Bins in Sheffield shown in video don’t require you to ‘tap your card to pay’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t quite right. Sheffield City Council says the bins shown in the video are specifically for nearby residents and businesses, who have to use a special fob to access them, not payment cards. Local businesses pay to use them similar to traditional commercial bins. There are freely accessible bins nearby for public use.

text: The rising number of vaccine doses given to children explains why autism rates have risen.

claimReview.title: Vaccines do not cause autism, despite reported rises – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Although children do receive more vaccine doses than in the past, and recorded rates of autism are higher, vaccines definitely don’t cause autism.

text: A picture shows Reform UK leader Nigel Farage visiting a seven-year-old with terminal brain cancer in hospital to fulfil their “final wish”.

claimReview.title: Picture of child with cancer edited to include Nigel Farage – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is fake. The picture does show a real child with cancer—an American boy who sadly died in October 2025. But the image has been edited with the help of AI to include Mr Farage.

text: A video shows Donald Trump telling Keir Starmer to “focus on the UK” because “the UK people didn’t elect you to be a commentator, they elected you to govern”.

claimReview.title: Another AI-generated video of Donald Trump criticising Keir Starmer circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence Donald Trump said this. The audio in this clip is not authentic and was generated using AI.

text: A video shows a man dumping rubbish in a London river.

claimReview.title: Viral video of man dumping rubbish in water was filmed in Mumbai, not London – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The clip was filmed in Mumbai, not London.

text: Figures from an Election Maps UK projection show only the Greens can stop Reform UK in the Gorton and Denton by-election.

claimReview.title: Green Party by-election bar chart claim is misleading – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. The most recent projection from Election Maps UK for Gorton and Denton suggests the Greens will see the second largest increase in vote share compared to the 2024 election, behind Reform UK. But it also suggests that Labour will still hold the seat.

text: The Green Party has confirmed their candidate in the Gorton and Denton by-election is Melissa Poulton.

claimReview.title: Posts on social media incorrectly name Green Party by-election candidate – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is incorrect. The Greens had not confirmed their candidate when these posts were shared, and have now confirmed Hannah Spencer will contest the seat.

text: A picture shows the moment US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents shot Alex Pretti.

claimReview.title: AI-enhanced image of Minneapolis shooting shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Although this image comes from a still of the real video of the shooting, it has been enhanced with artificial intelligence.

text: A Freddo chocolate bar cost 10p in 2000 and is now 35p.

claimReview.title: Figures used in social media posts comparing prices in 2000 to 2026 are not quite right – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Correct, though some retailers currently sell Freddos for more than 35p.

text: Nigel Farage said Donald Trump’s comments about NATO troops during the war in Afghanistan were “correct”, adding: “The Americans fought and died on the front lines and the British-led NATO armies consolidated the ground taken.”

claimReview.title: Nigel Farage said Trump’s comments about NATO troops in Afghanistan were ‘wrong’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not a real quote from Mr Farage, as far as we can tell. Reform UK has said he never said it.

text: Energy cost £300 a year in 2000 and is now £2,200 a year.

claimReview.title: Figures used in social media posts comparing prices in 2000 to 2026 are not quite right – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The 2000 figure appears to be based on the price of only electricity or gas, and not a dual fuel bill. The figure for 2000 appears too low for average domestic energy bills in 2000, and the other figure too high for average bills in 2025.

text: Images show men in balaclavas slashing ‘migrant dinghies’.

claimReview.title: Fake pictures of ‘British vigilantes’ slashing small boats shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These pictures aren’t real. There are a number of visual clues which suggest they were very likely made using artificial intelligence (AI).

text: The average house price was £84,000 in 2000 and is £296,000 in 2026.

claimReview.title: Figures used in social media posts comparing prices in 2000 to 2026 are not quite right – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: According to the government’s House Price Index, in January 2000 the average house price was £78,000. In November 2025, the most recent month we have data for, it was £271,000. Other sources offer estimates closer to those in the posts, however.

text: A pint was £1.90 in 2000 and is now £5.50.

claimReview.title: Figures used in social media posts comparing prices in 2000 to 2026 are not quite right – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This may be based on data that is not comparable. The comparable data we have shows the average price of a pint was £1.95 in January 2000 and was £4.83 in January 2025.

text: The HAARP research facility in Alaska is behind recent appearances of the Northern Lights.

claimReview.title: No, the Northern Lights aren’t caused by HAARP – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Not true. The Northern Lights were caused by a severe geomagnetic storm produced by the sun and not by research carried out by HAARP.

claimReview.title: HAARP did not cause recent Northern Lights seen in UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t right. The Northern Lights were caused by a severe geomagnetic storm produced by the sun and not by HAARP.

text: A video shows a young Ukrainian soldier crying and saying he doesn’t want to die.

claimReview.title: Fake video of Ukrainian soldier crying circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video isn’t real and was made using artificial intelligence.

text: Salaries were £18,500 in 2000 and are now £35,000.

claimReview.title: Figures used in social media posts comparing prices in 2000 to 2026 are not quite right – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The median salary for all employees in 2000 was £15,800 and was £32,890 in 2025, while the median salary for full time employees was £18,848 in 2000 and was £39,039 in 2025 (though methodology changes means these figures aren’t directly comparable).

text: Posts claim to show doctors from Guy’s and St Thomas’ NHS Foundation Trust applying weight loss patches and losing weight over a period of time.

claimReview.title: Fake AI doctors endorse weight loss patches on social media – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These claims aren’t real and the posts feature videos made using artificial intelligence.

text: Tesco is giving away free boxes of “essential groceries” worth £40 to Facebook users.

claimReview.title: Facebook posts promoting free food boxes from Tesco aren’t genuine – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine offer from Tesco.

text: David Lammy stated that everyone in the UK is £6,000 (or £5,000) a year better off since Labour was elected.

claimReview.title: No evidence David Lammy said people are now £6,000 better off under Labour – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We can find no evidence that Mr Lammy ever made this claim.

text: An old photo shows President Trump with disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein surrounded by young women.

claimReview.title: Fake image of young Donald Trump with Jeffrey Epstein recirculates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real. It was very likely created with artificial intelligence.

text: A British old aged pensioner receives £6,000 a year in financial assistance from the government.

claimReview.title: Inaccurate comparison of pensioner and ‘illegal immigrant’ benefits recirculates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The full new state pension is worth £11,973 a year, while the full basic state pension is worth £9,175 a year. There are also other forms of means-tested financial support available to some pensioners.

text: The Guardian has published an opinion piece about Christmas being deeply offensive to Muslims.

claimReview.title: Fake Guardian headline about Christmas being ‘offensive’ to Muslims shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not a real Guardian article. It was first shared by a satirical account.

text: The signals emitted by 5G towers are damaging to humans, animals and plants, and can cause health conditions, including heart and vision problems.

claimReview.title: Inaccurate poster warning about 5G health risks circulates again – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence that 5G technology is harmful to human health when used within the recommended exposure limits.

text: A video shows Iranians in the street taking part in anti-government protests.

claimReview.title: Video of clashes in Greece shared with claims it shows recent protests in Iran – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This footage was actually filmed in Thessaloniki, Greece, in November 2025  following a rap concert.

text: “Illegal immigrants” and refugees living in Britain receive £29,000 a year from the government.

claimReview.title: Inaccurate comparison of pensioner and ‘illegal immigrant’ benefits recirculates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. People in the UK without the right to be here aren’t entitled to claim public funds. Asylum seekers are entitled to some financial assistance from the government, but not as much as these posts claim. Refugees can claim benefits on the same terms as UK citizens, but they’re not entitled to £29,000 per year by virtue of their refugee status.

text: Screen time damages toddlers’ ability to speak, according to a new study.

claimReview.title: Government research doesn’t prove screen time ‘damages’ toddlers’ speech – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The study does not say this. It finds an association between higher screen time and lower vocabulary, but specifically says this does not prove that one causes the other.

text: Argos is selling iPhones for just £9.99 to people who fill in a customer service survey.

claimReview.title: No, Argos isn’t selling iPhones for £9.99 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Argos has confirmed this offer isn’t genuine.

text: Liz Truss receives a £125k per year ex PM pension for life.

claimReview.title: Liz Truss is not entitled to a ‘£125k per year ex PM pension for life’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Former prime ministers don’t receive their own special pensions, but are part of the ministerial scheme that provides a pension on retirement. They’re entitled to claim up to £115,000 a year though the Public Duty Cost Allowance, but this is for expenses associated with continuing public duties and is not a pension.

text: Ahead of the 2016 US presidential election, the-then Democratic presidential candidate Hillary Clinton emailed the Democratic National Committee interim chair Donna Brazile, saying that if that “bastard” wins, “we’re all going to hang from nooses”.

claimReview.title: Widely debunked Hillary Clinton ‘nooses’ quote recirculates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence this quote is real, and it has been debunked many times.

text: A video shows citizens of Venezuela ripping down a poster of Nicolás Maduro after he was seized by the United States.

claimReview.title: Viral video of protesters tearing down Maduro billboard is from 2024 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video actually dates back to July 2024, and was filmed during protests after a disputed presidential election.

text: A video shows a “recently arrived migrant” who was “removed from a taxpayer funded hotel” showing off his new home whilst his asylum claim is being processed.

claimReview.title: Property investor’s video falsely shared as ‘migrant showing off new house’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t right. The video was filmed by a British property investor, and shows him giving a tour of a house up for sale. The investor confirmed he is not an asylum seeker or “in receipt of any public funds”.

text: Laura Kuenssberg called for Nigel Farage’s microphone to be cut off in a heated interview on the Sunday Morning programme, which led to Mr Farage walking out.

claimReview.title: Fake transcript of Farage-Kuenssberg clash shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The BBC has confirmed this content is fake. The pictures accompanying the quotes contain an AI watermark.

text: Coughing really hard can help someone if they’re having a heart attack.

claimReview.title: Myth that coughing hard can help during a heart attack recirculates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. This is not recommended medical advice for treating a suspected heart attack, and it risks making a person's condition worse. If you think you are having a heart attack you should call 999 immediately.

text: The government insists it has halved the number of hotels housing asylum seekers since it came to power, from 400 down to around 200.

claimReview.title: Sky News corrects claim about asylum hotel closures under Labour – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The number of these hotels has fallen from the peak of over 400 in summer 2023 to around 200 now, but the majority of this decrease took place under the previous government. Some Labour MPs have previously wrongly made this claim, with at least one since correcting.

text: A video showing a woman lighting a cigarette from a burning portrait of the Supreme Leader of Iran was filmed in Iran.

claimReview.title: Video of woman burning portrait of Iran’s Supreme Leader was filmed in Canada – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is incorrect. The clip was actually recorded in a town near Toronto, Canada.

text: A video filmed from above shows Hurricane Melissa approaching Jamaica.

claimReview.title: Video appearing to show Hurricane Melissa from above is AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video isn’t genuine. It has been generated using artificial intelligence.

text: An image shows a man who was recently hit by a car in the UK.

claimReview.title: Facebook posts don’t show man recently hit by car – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The image is of a man who was hospitalised with Covid-19 in the US in 2021 and died that year.

text: A marine animal trainer named Jessica Radcliffe was recently killed by an orca during a live performance, and images and videos show the attack and its aftermath.

claimReview.title: Was a marine animal trainer called ‘Jessica Radcliffe’ killed by an orca? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. There’s no evidence of any such attack or that a trainer by this name ever actually existed. She is described as “fictional” by one early YouTube video making the claims. Many images and videos supposedly relating to the attack were created with artificial intelligence.

text: Over-50s can get an M&S Collection Hamper for £10 if they fill in a short questionnaire.

claimReview.title: M&S isn’t selling ‘collection hampers’ to the over-50s for £10 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine offer from Marks & Spencer.

text: A video compilation of 16 clips shows Hurricane Melissa hitting Jamaica.

claimReview.title: Footage used in viral ‘Hurricane Melissa’ compilation is old – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. Of these clips, 15 have been online since before Hurricane Melissa began to develop as a storm, or hit Jamaica.

text: A parent has posted an image of their teenage daughter who has gone missing in the UK.

claimReview.title: Online appeals for ‘missing’ daughter called Meghan Roberts are hoaxes – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is a hoax. The image shared in these Facebook posts shows a young woman with a different name who went missing, and was subsequently found safe, in the United States.

text: A video shows the Global Sumud Flotilla carrying activists towards Gaza.

claimReview.title: Miscaptioned video shows Turkish football fans, not the Gaza aid flotilla – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video doesn’t show that flotilla. It is actually fans of the Turkish football club Galatasaray celebrating a title win in May 2025.

text: Argos is giving away HP laptops to people over 25 who complete an online form.

claimReview.title: Argos is not giving away HP laptops – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. Argos has confirmed the offers are not genuine.

text: Keir Starmer says everyone in the UK will be required to have mandatory digital ID.

claimReview.title: Digital ID won’t be mandatory for ‘everyone in the UK’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Under government plans digital ID would be needed in order to work in the UK, but those who are not looking to work, such as people who are retired, would not be required to have it. We couldn’t find any evidence Mr Starmer claimed digital IDs would be mandatory for everyone.

text: The government is introducing a £10 charge for GP appointments and fines of up to £30 for missed appointments, from November 2025.

claimReview.title: The government isn’t introducing a £10 charge for GP appointments – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no evidence there are any plans to implement charges for NHS GP appointments or fines for missed appointments.

text: A video shows the Air India plane that crashed recently in Ahmedabad taking off.

claimReview.title: Old footage of Air India plane taking off from Heathrow shared as Ahmedabad crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This footage has been online for over a year and actually shows an Air India Boeing 777 taking off from London Heathrow Airport in May 2024. The plane that crashed in Ahmedabad was a Boeing 787.

text: Starting 1 December 2025 everyone in the UK will be expected to stay indoors after 11pm unless they hold verified permission to travel.

claimReview.title: An 11pm curfew is not being introduced next month – Full Fact

text: Facebook users in locations across the UK are seeking help returning a necklace containing cremation ashes to its owner.

claimReview.title: Hoax posts about lost cremation ashes circulate on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These posts are hoaxes. The item pictured appears to have been found in the US state of Wisconsin and returned to its owner earlier this year.

text: Multiverse, a company founded by Tony Blair’s son Euan, has been chosen to run the government’s new digital ID scheme.

claimReview.title: Has Euan Blair’s company Multiverse been chosen to run the government’s new digital ID scheme? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true, according to both the government and Multiverse, which is an “upskilling company”, not a software developer. The government has not announced any partner for the project.

text: The House of Lords has launched a petition to strip Prince Harry of all his royal titles.

claimReview.title: No evidence of a House of Lords petition to strip Prince Harry of royal titles – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is currently no such formal petition being put to the government or Parliament, and previous petitions about this have been rejected. We could find no evidence of the House of Lords itself, or its individual members, launching it either. A House of Lords spokesperson confirmed they had no knowledge of any such petition.

text: A video shows the inside of the aeroplane moments before the Air India crash on 12 June.

claimReview.title: Video of plane’s cabin shows turbulence on a Pakistani flight, not the Air India crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video actually shows turbulence on a domestic flight in Pakistan from May 2025 and is unrelated to the recent Air India disaster.

text: The Guardian published an opinion article by Yvette Cooper headlined: “If you suspect a family member, a neighbour, a friend or a work colleague of being Far-Right please inform the police immediately”.

claimReview.title: Fake Yvette Cooper Guardian article circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The Guardian confirmed it has published no such article.

text: Over-50s can get a “Morrisons Family Food Box” for £10.

claimReview.title: Online claims Morrisons is giving away £10 food boxes to “seniors” are false – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Morrisons has confirmed that this offer isn’t genuine.

text: From 1 November 2025, the government is imposing a ban on the use of central heating after 9pm, even in winter. People who breach the cut-off time could face heavy fines.

claimReview.title: No, the government isn’t banning central heating after 9pm – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This policy isn’t real, and there are no cut-off times forcing people to turn off their central heating.

text: The last three home secretaries are Suella Braverman, David Lammy and Shabana Mahmood.

claimReview.title: Viral list of ‘last three home secretaries’ is incorrect – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. Mr Lammy has never been home secretary, and Ms Braverman is not one of the last three home secretaries.

text: A clip shows GB News presenter Patrick Christys reporting that 43 Labour MPs have “just resigned” after “the biggest UK scandal in decades” in which £22 billion has “vanished” from Labour’s finances.

claimReview.title: Thousands share video making false claims about Labour MPs resigning over ‘scandal’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There has been no mass resignation of Labour MPs and there is no evidence of any such scandal. This is not a real clip of Mr Christys—it was almost certainly created with artificial intelligence.

text: Over-50s can get a Morrisons Family Food Box for £10 if they fill in an online questionnaire.

claimReview.title: Over-50s can’t get a ‘Family Food Box’ for just £10 from Morrisons – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Morrisons confirmed this is not a genuine offer.
