text: Morrisons is selling boxes of food for £10 or less to those who fill out a questionnaire.

claimReview.title: Morrisons is not selling ‘food boxes’ for just £10 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The retailer confirmed this is not a genuine offer from them.

text: A video shows a man throwing a bucket of water over MP Zarah Sultana as she is speaking next to a Palestinian flag.

claimReview.title: Video of man throwing water over Zarah Sultana MP isn’t real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video isn’t real and is likely an AI deepfake made using an old image of Ms Sultana.

text: A 13-year-old boy named Harley Steward has gone missing and this has been reported to police, with Facebook users in various UK locations warned to look out for him.

claimReview.title: Police forces across the UK have not been searching for a missing 13-year-old called ‘Harley Steward’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Police forces in these areas say they have no record of any such missing person.

text: A video from Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, on 8 May 2025, shows the power of the Indian defence system.

claimReview.title: Video shows Israel’s Iron Dome not India defence system – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video is not related to the recent India-Pakistan conflict. It has been online for at least four years, and shows Israel’s air defence system, known as the Iron Dome, in action.

text: People leaving the UK for any purpose will be charged a £500 ‘exit fee’ from November.

claimReview.title: No, the government isn’t introducing a £500 ‘exit fee’ to leave the UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no evidence of the government introducing this policy.

text: There are 1.2 million illegal immigrants in the UK.

claimReview.title: Are there 1.2 million ‘illegal immigrants’ in the UK? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This figure is both out of date and unreliable. It appears to be based on an estimate of the UK’s unauthorised immigrant population in 2017 and was published by the Pew Research Center, which has since acknowledged that its methodology was flawed.

text: Currys is offering PlayStation 5 Slim games consoles for under £5 to people who complete a survey.

claimReview.title: Currys £5 PlayStation offer is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Currys has confirmed that this is not a genuine offer.

text: Donald Trump told People magazine in 1998: “If I were to run, I'd run as a Republican. They’re the dumbest group of voters in the country. They believe anything on Fox News. I could lie and they'd still eat it up. I bet my numbers would be terrific.”

claimReview.title: No, Donald Trump did not say Republicans were the ‘dumbest group of voters’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is a fake quote. People magazine has previously said they have no record of Mr Trump saying this, or “anything like this quote”.

claimReview.title: Donald Trump did not call Republicans ‘the dumbest group of voters’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This quote is fabricated. People magazine has previously confirmed that it had no record of having published any such interview or exchange with Mr Trump.

claimReview.title: Fake Donald Trump quote about ‘dumbest’ voters circulates again – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This quote isn’t real. People magazine has previously said it has no record of Mr Trump saying this, or of any such interview with him that year.

text: People who fill in an online survey can receive a “Lego mystery box” from Lego as a thank you.

claimReview.title: No, Lego is not giving away ‘mystery boxes’ to people who fill in a survey – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Lego has confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: London is in meltdown after Sadiq Khan cancelled a royal event, the King’s garden bridge ceremony, over security concerns without informing King Charles.

claimReview.title: False claims Sadiq Khan cancelled non-existent royal ‘garden bridge ceremony’ circulate online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. No such event took place, and the ‘garden bridge ceremony’ doesn’t exist.

text: A 2014 post from Donald Trump on Twitter, now X, said that “any president that tries meeting with Putin is a tyrant and should not be president”.

claimReview.title: No evidence Trump said any US president meeting with Putin was a ‘tyrant’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence this was posted by Mr Trump. The image supposedly showing his post has been circulating since at least 2018.

text: A video of destroyed buildings shows recent scenes in Tel Aviv, Israel.

claimReview.title: Video supposedly showing destroyed buildings in Tel Aviv almost certainly AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not real footage, and was almost certainly created with artificial intelligence.

text: A video shows real footage from inside the Air India Flight 171 moments before the crash in Ahmedabad.

claimReview.title: Video of smoke-filled cabin is from 2020 Ryanair incident not recent Air India crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. The video is of an incident that occurred on a Ryanair flight from Bucharest to London Stansted in January 2020.

text: The chickenpox vaccine is poison.

claimReview.title: Chickenpox vaccine claims: fact checked – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The chickenpox vaccine is safe and not poisonous. The NHS says serious side effects are “very rare”.

text: Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni criticised Sir Keir Starmer as “cringe” over Britain’s role in the Gaza ceasefire agreement and said “if anything he harmed peace negotiations”.

claimReview.title: No evidence Italy’s PM said Keir Starmer ‘harmed’ Gaza peace deal – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We can find no evidence Ms Meloni ever said this. A spokesperson for the Italian embassy in London confirmed she did not make the comments.

text: Argos is practically giving away GoPro HERO13 cameras to people who fill out a form.

claimReview.title: Argos isn’t ‘practically giving away’ GoPro cameras to anyone who fills in form – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A spokesperson for Argos confirmed this is not a genuine offer from the retailer.

text: mRNA vaccines encourage new mutations in respiratory viruses.

claimReview.title: Robert F Kennedy Jr wrong about mRNA vaccines’ effectiveness – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. Experts say mutations occur randomly in nature and while immunity may drive the evolution of new viral variants, this is not specific to mRNA vaccines but true of other vaccines and natural infection too.

text: A photo shows a road where five veterans have decorated their homes with England flags, which has led to neighbours complaining to the police.

claimReview.title: Viral photo of street with England flags is not recent, it’s actually from 2023 Nike advert – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Misleading. The road was decorated like this for a 2023 Nike commercial, and was the backdrop for a scene featuring Lioness Chloe Kelly. It’s not related to the current social media campaign to fly flags in public spaces.

text: Cancer is part of the healing response, and tumours are created by the body as a bag to collect toxins contaminating the bloodstream.

claimReview.title: No, tumours aren’t ‘bags’ of toxins and biopsies don’t release them – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: A biopsy does not burst a ‘bag’ or release toxins—because tumours are not bags of toxins. Biopsies involve removing a small sample of cells to determine whether they’re cancerous.

text: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer has invited Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa for a state visit to the UK.

claimReview.title: No evidence UK has invited Syrian President for state visit – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office confirmed there are no current plans for the UK to host President Ahmed al-Sharaa.

text: Repeated cash use could cost you £250 and retailers who accept it will be fined £500.

claimReview.title: No, you won’t need digital ID for cash payments over £20 in the new year – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no evidence of any such policy and clips claiming to show Keir Starmer discussing this use fake audio.

text: Footage of Albert Bourla, Pfizer’s CEO, shows him discussing a medication which contains an ingestible sensor chip.

claimReview.title: Edited video of Pfizer CEO circulates again online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is real footage from the World Economic Forum event in Davos in 2018, but Mr Bourla is talking about a medication system approved in 2017, not developed by Pfizer.

text: Statistics show without a doubt that the current Labour government has allowed the biggest influx of migrants in British history.

claimReview.title: Has this Labour government ‘allowed the biggest influx of migrants in British history’? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: It’s not clear what this claim is based on but neither we nor the Migration Observatory have seen any data to support it. ONS figures suggest annual immigration to the UK was at a record level in 2023, though we don’t yet have comparative data covering only Labour’s time in office. Small boat arrivals have been at record levels in 2025 but these represent only a small proportion of all migrants.

text: Korean researchers said they found proof the covid vaccines raised the risk of six types of cancer.

claimReview.title: Daily Mail corrects article about Covid vaccines and cancer – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. The Korean researchers said they found an association between the vaccines and cancer, but specifically said they didn’t know the vaccines were the cause. There is no good evidence Covid vaccines cause cancer.

text: Pensioners will be banned from driving at night from 10 October, and could face a fine or lose their licence if they don’t comply.

claimReview.title: Fake nighttime pensioner driving ban rumour spreads online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not true—a spokesperson for the Department for Transport told Full Fact the claims made in these videos are “not correct”. These videos also feature inauthentic audio with old footage of Sir Keir Starmer.

text: Amazon is giving away laptops for “just $3”.

claimReview.title: Social media posts promoting Amazon laptop giveaway are fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Amazon has confirmed this is false.

text: Unemployment has gone up every single month under the Labour government.

claimReview.title: Unemployment has risen under Labour - but it hasn’t gone up ‘every single month’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. The number of people who are unemployed and the unemployment rate have both risen since Labour came into government, but they haven’t gone up in every single month.

text: The Red Arrows used colourless white smoke in their flypast over the 2025 Glastonbury Festival, rather than red, white and blue, so as not to “offend”.

claimReview.title: Why didn’t the Red Arrows use red, white and blue smoke over Glastonbury? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence for this claim and the RAF has said it is not true. The use of white smoke is normal when the Red Arrows are repositioning between operating bases, as they have limited capacity for coloured dye, and this was the case when they appeared at Glastonbury this year.

text: Photos show a coup in the Ivory Coast on 19 May 2025.

claimReview.title: There was no coup in Ivory Coast in May, as claimed – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There was no coup in the Ivory Coast last month, and these photos show unrelated incidents, including a protest in Kenya.

text: Images of a little girl peering through a small gap have been shared online with a Palestinian flag emoji, and the suggestion that she is in distress.

claimReview.title: Images of girl looking through hole in a wall shared with misleading captions on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. The images are taken from a video which shows a child playing and looking through a hole in the wall. There's no evidence it was filmed in Gaza or the West Bank.

text: A video shows “the largest demonstration in history for Palestine in Japan after Sydney, Australia”.

claimReview.title: Video shared with claims it shows a large ‘pro-Palestine’ demo in Japan is AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t a genuine video. It has been created with artificial intelligence (AI).

text: A video shows 20,000 people singing an offensive chant about Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer.

claimReview.title: Clip from VE Day concert edited to include recording of anti-Starmer chant at nightclub – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not the clip’s original audio.  The footage shows people at a concert celebrating the 80th anniversary of VE Day, and there are no reports of any such chanting there. The audio actually comes from people chanting at a nightclub in Hereford.

text: The government introduced a £100 annual NHS Access card in October, without which you won’t be able to access healthcare.

claimReview.title: No, you don’t need to buy a ‘£100 access card’ to use NHS services – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such card exists. The NHS remains free for UK residents.

text: Aldi is giving away food boxes worth £40 to anyone who engages with certain social media posts.

claimReview.title: Aldi is not giving away £40 food boxes on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Aldi has confirmed this is not a genuine offer from them.

text: Footage shows migrants stealing items from a graveyard in the UK.

claimReview.title: Video does not show ‘migrants’ stealing items from UK graveyard – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This footage was filmed in Ukraine. It is unclear what the people are doing by the graves.

text: A photo shows chaotic scenes in the English Channel with many people in life jackets crowded onto a small boat.

claimReview.title: Image does not show migrants arriving in the English Channel – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. The picture was taken in 2021 and shows people off the coast of Libya.

text: A clip shows live footage from inside London-bound Air India flight 171 before it crashed on 12 June in Ahmedabad.

claimReview.title: Clip from 2023 Nepal plane accident shared as footage from recent Air India crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This actually shows a plane crash in Nepal in January 2023.

text: From 1 October the government will introduce a £15 monthly clean water levy for every household in the UK.

claimReview.title: No, a £15 'clean water levy' isn't being rolled out across the UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not true—a government spokesperson told Full Fact the claim is “completely false”. Videos on social media making this claim feature inauthentic audio with old footage of Mr Starmer.

text: From 1 October the government will introduce a crackdown on driving offences.

claimReview.title: The government hasn’t announced ‘one of the harshest crackdowns’ UK drivers have ever seen – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A government spokesperson told Full Fact these claims are “untrue”. Videos on social media making this claim feature inauthentic audio with old footage of Sir Keir Starmer.

text: In the summer of 2021 we knew that the Covid vaccine wasn’t stopping infection or transmission.

claimReview.title: Covid vaccine claims at the Reform UK conference: fact checked – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is potentially misleading. While the vaccine didn’t stop all infection or transmission in 2021, a UKHSA report at the time said the Covid vaccines then available were effective against infection and were preventing transmission.

text: A clip shows Muslim migrants having a picnic at a cemetery in Ireland.

claimReview.title: Video shows scenes in a cemetery in Belgium, not Ireland – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This footage was actually taken at a multifaith cemetery in Brussels, Belgium.

text: A picture compilation shows Prince William making an emotional speech at a state banquet at the Élysée Palace, with Princess Catherine crying, and another image of the royal couple embracing.

claimReview.title: Likely AI images of William and Kate shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These aren’t real pictures, and were likely created with artificial intelligence. They do not match genuine photographs from the event, and there are discrepancies with how both Royals appear in real life.

text: From December 2025 carrying uncovered hot drinks on main streets will be prohibited and carry a £30 fine.

claimReview.title: You won’t be fined for carrying uncovered hot drinks down the street – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no such policy.

text: There have been record levels of returns of people who have no legal right to be here and record levels of deportations under Labour.

claimReview.title: Immigration returns aren’t at ‘record levels’ under Labour – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not correct, based on official returns data. Neither the overall number of immigration returns nor the number of enforced returns carried out during Labour’s first year in office is a record for a 12-month period.

text: Amazon is giving away HP laptops for just £3 to people living in England.

claimReview.title: Amazon is not giving away laptops for £3 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Amazon has confirmed this is not a legitimate offer from the company.

text: Donald Trump said he might buy England and turn it into a US state.

claimReview.title: No evidence Donald Trump said he might buy ‘all of England’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence that this is a genuine quote from the US president.

text: A video taken inside the aircraft shows the “last moment” before the Air India plane crash.

claimReview.title: Old easyJet video shared as ‘last moment’ before Air India crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video dates back to at least March 2020, five years before the Air India disaster.

text: Biopsies split open the bags created by the tumours and release toxic matter into the body.

claimReview.title: No, tumours aren’t ‘bags’ of toxins and biopsies don’t release them – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: A biopsy does not burst a ‘bag’ or release toxins—because tumours are not bags of toxins. Biopsies involve removing a small sample of cells to determine whether they’re cancerous.

text: Covid vaccines caused a 300% rise in miscarriage and cancer rates, and a 1,000% rise in neurological disorders.

claimReview.title: Covid vaccines did not cause a 300% rise in cancer and miscarriage rates – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. These figures come from a calculation based on faulty data. The corrected figures were much lower, and did not show a rise in these conditions caused by the Covid vaccines anyway.

text: A video of a crowd of women in niqabs walking on a street was filmed in London.

claimReview.title: Video shows Muslim women in Indonesia not London – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. The footage is from an Islamic boarding school in Indonesia.

text: High cholesterol will make you live longer and never have a heart attack.

claimReview.title: John’s story: when health misinformation leads to harm – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: High cholesterol is a well established risk factor for heart disease and strokes.

claimReview.title: Having high cholesterol is not better for your health – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: High cholesterol is a well established risk factor for heart disease and strokes.

text: A video shows Emmanuel Macron saying “The way Trump had police stop me on the streets of New York is really disgusting. All of this happened just because I acknowledged the existence of Palestine.”

claimReview.title: Fake video of Emmanuel Macron claiming Donald Trump blocked his car in retaliation for recognising Palestine circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The French president did not say this. The audio in this clip is not authentic.

text: Labour MP Naz Shah said: “Those abused girls in Rotherham and elsewhere just need to shut their mouths. For the good of diversity.”

claimReview.title: Labour MP did not say victims of grooming gangs should ‘shut their mouths’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Ms Shah didn’t say this. She retweeted then quickly deleted this quote from a parody account on Twitter (now X) in 2017, and has said the sharing of the post was a “genuine accident”.

text: A video of Pfizer CEO, Albert Bourla, shows him saying at the World Economic Forum that a company goal was by 2023 to reduce the number of people in the world by 50%.

claimReview.title: Edited video of Pfizer CEO circulates again online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This clip has been altered. Mr Bourla was talking about a goal to reduce the number of people who could not afford their medicines by 50%, not about halving the population.

text: A planning notice shows an application has been submitted for a four-storey temporary structure, which would provide accommodation for up to 800 asylum seekers, to be built at St Thomas' Recreation Ground on 147 Hempshaw Lane, Offerton in Stockport, Greater Manchester.

claimReview.title: Fake planning notice falsely claims application lodged for Stockport asylum seeker housing – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This isn’t a real planning notice. Stockport Council has said the notices are not legitimate and no such planning application has been submitted to it.

text: Angela Rayner broke the law by cancelling some local council elections.

claimReview.title: Angela Rayner didn’t ‘break the law’ by postponing some local elections – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t the case. Nine council elections in England were postponed from May 2025 to May 2026, so that the councils could take part in local government reorganisation. Section 87 of the Local Government Act 2000 gives the secretary of state the power to make an order to change the year in which the ordinary election to a local authority takes place.

text: A new law coming into force in November 2025 will introduce a £200 ‘sustainability tax’ on all car owners.

claimReview.title: The government isn’t introducing a new £200 ‘sustainability’ tax on car owners – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. While most vehicles are subject to road tax, which underwent some changes in April, there is no additional £200 sustainability charge for car owners being introduced from November 2025.

text: Asylum seekers are being given Freedom Passes for free or discounted London travel.

claimReview.title: Are asylum seekers given Freedom Passes for free travel in London? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Asylum seekers can only apply for a Freedom Pass if they meet  the criteria around age and disability which applies to all London residents. There is no special provision for asylum seekers.

text: From 1st January 2026, phone calls longer than 10 minutes will be automatically recorded in the UK.

claimReview.title: No, phone calls longer than 10 minutes will not be automatically recorded from 2026 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Ofcom confirmed there are no such requirements on telecoms providers.

text: A video shows Donald Trump announcing a ban on Tesla production in the United States after Elon Musk “stabbed him in the back”.

claimReview.title: Video of Donald Trump announcing US ban on Tesla production is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. President Trump did not say he would ban Tesla production and the clip was edited using artificial intelligence.

text: Visitors to London need to learn Bengali to avoid getting lost, as evidenced by a photo of a sign in Bengali that says Whitechapel Station.

claimReview.title: Post about Whitechapel Station’s Bengali sign is missing context – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The signage at Whitechapel Station is in both English and Bengali. The photo doesn't show a similar sign next to it saying the same in English.

text: Toby Carvery is offering free meals to people who like certain Facebook posts.

claimReview.title: More fake Toby Carvery offers circulate on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A spokesperson for Mitchells & Butlers, the company that owns Toby Carvery, confirmed these are not genuine offers.

text: An Associated Press news report says Donald Trump has been barred from consideration for all future Nobel Prizes.

claimReview.title: Fake AP report claiming Trump disqualified from Nobel Prize spreads online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This report is fake and no such decision has been taken by the Nobel Prize committee.

text: Sir Keir Starmer has announced that from January 2026 parents of newborn babies will receive a £1,000 grant from the government.

claimReview.title: No, the government isn’t giving £1,000 grants to new parents from January 2026 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such policy has been announced. Social media videos making this claim feature fake audio, which was likely AI-generated.

text: John Lewis is offering Bugaboo Butterfly pushchairs for £2 or £3 to people who complete a questionnaire.

claimReview.title: John Lewis pushchair offer is not genuine – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a legitimate John Lewis offer.

text: From 1 January 2026, people could see any amount above £5,000 they have in savings redirected into a national debt repayment fund.

claimReview.title: No, savings above £5,000 aren’t being taken to pay off the national debt – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The Treasury confirmed there is no such policy.

text: Argos is practically giving away PlayStation 5 consoles to people who fill out a form as part of a hidden 30th anniversary thank you campaign.

claimReview.title: Another fake Argos PlayStation 5 offer circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A spokesperson for Argos confirmed to Full Fact that this is not a genuine offer from the retailer.

text: A video shows Pakistani migrants removing a Union Jack flag and raising the Pakistan flag in response to the ‘raise the colours’ campaign.

claimReview.title: Video does not show Union Jack being replaced with Pakistan flag – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. The clip actually shows the flag of Pakistan being flown at the Consulate of Pakistan in Glasgow to mark the country’s Independence Day. No Union Jack was removed.

text: Argos is selling Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra smartphones for £2.

claimReview.title: No, Argos is not selling Samsung smartphones for £2 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Argos has confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: UK residents now have to pay dozens of different taxes, none of which existed 100 years ago.

claimReview.title: Viral list incorrectly claiming dozens of modern taxes didn’t exist 100 years ago recirculates – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. Income tax and levies on beer, tobacco and petrol have existed for more than a century, as well as a precursor to inheritance tax. Some of the taxes listed as modern-day taxes don’t exist in the UK.

claimReview.title: Viral list claiming dozens of taxes didn’t exist a century ago is wrong – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. Income tax, beer and tobacco levies and the precursor to inheritance tax all existed over 100 years ago in the UK. And there are a number of other taxes mentioned that aren’t in place in the UK.

claimReview.title: Income tax, fuel tax and inheritance tax all existed 100 years ago – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. Income tax, which is listed in the post, was first introduced in 1799. And there are a number of other taxes mentioned that aren’t in place in the UK.

text: In the past year Labour has halved the use of asylum hotels.

claimReview.title: Minister repeats incorrect claim about asylum hotel use under Labour – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. The number of asylum hotels in use was 213 when Labour formed a government in July 2024 and had decreased to 210 in July 2025. The number of asylum seekers in hotel accommodation increased in that period.

text: Images show a couple who are on the run and wanted for the murder of a two-year-old child in the UK.

claimReview.title: Warnings about baby killers on the run are false – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Posts claiming this are hoaxes. Almost identical claims have been made saying this took place in various places in the UK. There’s no evidence any such murder has taken place and both the images are from the US.

text: IKEA is giving away free boxes of leftover products to people who answer questions online.

claimReview.title: IKEA is not giving away boxes of free products – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. IKEA confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: An image shows Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein on a private jet.

claimReview.title: Image supposedly showing Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein on private jet isn’t real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real and was likely made using AI.

text: A video shows Princess Anne making a number of comments about Queen Camilla, including that she will “never bow” to her and saying “as long as I am alive I will be her nightmare”.

claimReview.title: Audio of Princess Anne talking about Queen Camilla is AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video uses AI-generated audio to sound like Princess Anne, and isn’t genuine.

text: Nigel Farage was named on Time magazine’s list of the 100 most influential people of 2025.

claimReview.title: Nigel Farage was not included on Time magazine’s list of 100 most influential people – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mr Farage does not appear on this list.

text: State pension contributions, with interest added, should generate a sum of almost £900,000 for pensioners when they retire.

claimReview.title: Viral Facebook pension posts get maths wrong again – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is a fundamental misunderstanding of how state pensions work. National Insurance contributions paid by employees and employers essentially fund that year’s state pensions, plus some other benefits. Some private pensions are invested, and the total sum can generate income on retirement.

text: The Prime Minister of Poland said: “How can 500 million Europeans ask 300 million Americans to protect them from 140 million Russians? But I'll tell you something even more astonishing—there are 2 billion Muslims asking the world to protect them from 7 million Jews”.

claimReview.title: No evidence Poland’s Prime Minister made comments comparing the global population of Muslims and Jews – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: That’s not quite correct. While the Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has said the first part of this quote about Europe, America and Russia, in the context of Europe building its defence, we could find no evidence he said the second part about Muslims and Jews.

text: From 12 October the UK government is introducing a rule that means you could be fined £100 for hanging laundry outside in your garden.

claimReview.title: No, you won’t be fined by the government for hanging washing outside – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such policy has been introduced.

text: Immigration increased four-fold under the Conservatives in five years.

claimReview.title: Is Keir Starmer right to claim immigration increased ‘four-fold’ under the Conservatives? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Estimated net migration increased four-fold between June 2018 and its peak in June 2023, while immigration almost doubled over the same period.

text: Toby Carvery is giving away free meals for two to Facebook users.

claimReview.title: More fake Toby Carvery offers circulate on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mitchells & Butlers, the parent company of Toby Carvery, has confirmed this isn’t a genuine offer.

text: A video includes footage of the recent accident in which footballers Diogo Jota and André Silva were killed.

claimReview.title: Footage of 2023 car accident in US falsely shared as Diogo Jota crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This footage shows a fatal accident in Washington, US, in September 2023.

text: Lego is selling mystery boxes for £3.

claimReview.title: Facebook posts falsely claim Lego is selling ‘mystery boxes’ for just £3 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The retailer has said this is not a genuine offer.

text: An audio recording captures the Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer saying that he hates Liverpool.

claimReview.title: Debunked Keir Starmer audio reappears ahead of Labour conference in Liverpool – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence this is a genuine recording. It was widely reported as a fake when it first appeared in October 2023.

text: A video shows a pro-Palestine crowd celebrating in Manchester in the wake of the Bondi Beach attack on a Jewish event.

claimReview.title: Clip does not show people in Manchester ‘celebrating’ the Bondi Beach attack – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The video predates the attack. It was filmed in Manchester and was posted online six months before the attack happened.

text: A video shows a luxury cruise ship caught on camera releasing waste directly into the sea.

claimReview.title: Video showing cruise ship spilling waste into the sea isn’t real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video isn’t real and was almost certainly AI-generated. There are discrepancies in the way the physics of the environment and ship are depicted, and a watermark suggests it was created using OpenAI’s video generation software.

text: A photograph shows a group of police officers kneeling in front of a group of Muslims.

claimReview.title: An image of policemen kneeling in front of a group of Muslims is probably AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is a fake image, probably generated with artificial intelligence (AI).

text: A picture shows extensive damage after Iran successfully hit Tel Aviv airport in Israel.

claimReview.title: Likely AI image of destroyed planes shared with claims it shows Tel Aviv airport – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t a real picture of an Iranian strike. It is a still from a video which has almost certainly been generated with artificial intelligence (AI).

text: Conservative MP for Mid Norfolk George Freeman said he is crossing the floor to join Reform UK and that the Conservative party has lost its way.

claimReview.title: Video of George Freeman MP announcing defection to Reform UK is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video isn’t real and Mr Freeman never said this. The clip was very likely made using artificial intelligence.

text: A picture shows an Israeli female pilot, Sarah Ahronot, who has been captured in Iran.

claimReview.title: Image doesn’t show ‘Israeli pilot captured in Iran’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. The image is actually of Lieutenant Daniela Figueroa, who in 2021 became Chile’s first female pilot in the country’s navy.

text: Argos is selling PlayStations for £2 if you fill out an online form.

claimReview.title: Argos isn’t selling PlayStations for £2 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Argos has confirmed this offer isn’t genuine.

text: Argos is offering an “iPad Pro 2022” to people who answer a small survey.

claimReview.title: Argos is not offering people an iPad Pro if they fill in a survey – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Argos has confirmed this is not a genuine offer from them.

text: An image shows Donald Trump embracing convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

claimReview.title: Photo of Donald Trump embracing Jeffrey Epstein has been edited – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This picture has been edited. The original photograph showed Mr Trump with his daughter Ivanka. Her face has been edited out and replaced with Epstein’s.

text: Resident doctors got a 29% pay rise last year.

claimReview.title: Resident doctors’ 29% pay rise was over a three-year period – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The 29% figure for resident doctors in England actually represents the combined effect of several pay rises over three years, including the current one. It wasn’t all delivered last year.

text: Argos is practically giving away iPad Pro 11s to Facebook users who complete a survey on their website.

claimReview.title: Argos isn’t selling cheap iPad Pros to people who fill in a survey – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine Argos offer.

text: The UK government is limiting cash withdrawals over £200 a week.

claimReview.title: False claims about £200 cash withdrawal limits continue to be shared online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a real policy set to be introduced by the government.

text: Argos is selling HP laptops for £2 or £3 to those who answer questions online.

claimReview.title: Argos isn’t selling HP laptops for £3 to people who fill in a survey – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Argos has confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: Tesco is not celebrating Christmas this year, rebranding its Christmas trees as “evergreen” or “alpine” trees.

claimReview.title: Tesco hasn’t rebranded all its Christmas trees to ‘evergreen trees’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. The retailer describes at least one of its trees as “evergreen”, but it continues to sell other artificial trees labelled as Christmas trees on its website.

text: There is no autism among Amish communities.

claimReview.title: Amish people do vaccinate - and autism exists in Amish communities – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Studies show autism is present in Amish communities.

text: A video shows recent anti-government protests in Iran amid Israel-Iran airstrikes.

claimReview.title: Old Iran protest video shared with false claims it shows recent unrest – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is an old video showing protests in Iran in December 2017.

text: Keir Starmer has announced that all Labour MPs and the Royal Family will be exempt from digital ID.

claimReview.title: PM hasn’t announced royals and MPs digital ID exemption – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Mr Starmer has not said this. A government spokesperson confirmed digital ID will only be mandatory to prove your right to work, and that no exemptions have been announced, though whether MPs and royals will end up needing it isn't entirely clear.

text: From 1 October this year, free cash withdrawals in Britain will come to an end and from that date, a charge of £1.50 will apply to each ATM transaction.

claimReview.title: False claim that free cash withdrawals are ending from October shared widely online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t happening. UK Finance, the trade body for banking and financial services, says this claim is incorrect.

text: From 10 November people in the UK who use their heating after 9pm will be fined £750 and may have their energy cut off.

claimReview.title: People in the UK will not be fined £750 for using their heating after 9pm – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The government has announced no such policy.

text: Arsenal player Declan Rice has donated a $14 million bonus and sponsorship earnings to support a new initiative providing housing for homeless families with children in Tower Hamlets.

claimReview.title: Baseless claim that Declan Rice donated millions to Tower Hamlets Council spreads on social media – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. Tower Hamlets Council has said it is “fake news”. There’s no evidence that Declan Rice has donated any money to such a scheme.

text: UK residents over the age of 60 can claim a free lifetime exemption from paying the TV licence.

claimReview.title: No TV licence exemption for the over 60s – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no such blanket lifetime exemption for the over 60s, although some over the age of 75 can claim a free TV licence.

text: A picture shows a family from Sheffield welcoming Labour’s decision to remove the two-child benefit limit.

claimReview.title: Picture doesn’t show ‘family in Sheffield’ welcoming removal of two-child benefit cap – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This picture is from 2014 and shows a family in Pakistan, not Sheffield.

text: Tesco is celebrating its birthday by giving away a free food box to everyone who ‘likes’ a Facebook post.

claimReview.title: More posts claiming Tesco is giving away ‘free food boxes’ shared on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. A spokesperson for Tesco has confirmed the company is not giving away free food boxes.

text: A pictured couple is on the run in England, following the fatal shooting of an 89-year-old woman.

claimReview.title: Posts about ‘homicide suspects’ on the run are hoaxes – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Police forces in the areas where the couple were supposedly last seen say they are not investigating any such crime.

text: People will face a £300 charge for using too much electricity after 9pm, from December 2025.

claimReview.title: You won’t be charged £300 for using too much electricity after 9pm – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such charge is being introduced.

text: Amazon is giving away iPads to people aged 40 and older.

claimReview.title: No, Amazon is not ‘giving away’ iPads to the over-40s – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine offer from Amazon.

text: Morrisons is selling £10 food boxes to “seniors”.

claimReview.title: Morrisons is not selling £10 food boxes to ‘seniors’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine offer from the retailer.

text: Porridge oats advertising will be restricted by the junk food advertising ban.

claimReview.title: Ads for plain porridge oats have not been banned – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Only some “less healthy” porridge products will be affected by the ban. Plain porridge oats won’t be.

text: Every household in Britain will face a £290 monthly electricity charge from December 2025, regardless of whether they use a single unit of power, to keep the national grid stable.

claimReview.title: No, a new law isn’t being introduced to stop people playing music while driving – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such new monthly charge is being introduced, though most energy customers already pay standing charges.

text: A video shows China dropping aid on 17 May 2025.

claimReview.title: Video does not show China recently airdropping aid to Gaza – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t wholly accurate. While the video does depict an aid drop in Gaza, it has been circulating online since at least September 2024. And there’s no evidence that China has recently delivered aid to Gaza by air.

text: Asylum seekers in hotel accommodation have the choice between an iPhone or Samsung mobile on arrival, paid for by UK taxpayers, and receive £70 a week in addition to meals.

claimReview.title: Asylum seekers living in hotels do not receive £70 a week – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Asylum seekers are eligible for asylum support from the government, but this does not include a mobile phone, although phones were given to asylum seekers during the coronavirus pandemic and some charities also provide phones to asylum seekers. Asylum seekers receive £9.95 per person a week if their meals are provided with their accommodation, and £49.18 a week if not.

text: Muslims who use living areas within their homes as a place of worship are exempt from paying council tax.

claimReview.title: Muslims who use their homes as a place of worship aren’t exempt from council tax – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Owners of domestic properties, whether Muslim or any other religion, aren’t exempted from paying council tax if they claim that their home, or part of it, is used for religious purposes.

text: People magazine quoted Donald Trump in 1998 as saying Republicans were the "dumbest group of voters in the country”.

claimReview.title: Fake Donald Trump quote calling Republicans the ‘dumbest group of voters’ recirculates – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This quote isn’t real. People magazine has stated it has no record of this quote being published by the outlet.

text: The civil servant responsible for increasing the state pension age to 67 is retiring at age 61 with a £1.8 million pension pot.

claimReview.title: Claim about civil servant responsible for increasing pension age missing some context – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: It’s true the former permanent secretary at the Department for Work and Pensions had a pension equivalent to over £1.8 million, in 2017. But civil servants are only responsible for developing and implementing policy. He himself didn’t decide to raise the pension age.

claimReview.title: Posts about civil servant ‘responsible’ for increasing state pension age need context – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The civil servant in question, Sir Robert Devereux, actually retired as permanent secretary at the Department for Work and Pensions back in 2018. The figures for his pension at that time are broadly correct. But it’s important to note civil servants are “responsible” for developing and implementing policy, not for policy decisions themselves.

claimReview.title: Claims about civil servant ‘responsible’ for increase in state pension age shared online again – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Missing context. The civil servant in question, Sir Robert Devereux, actually retired as permanent secretary at the Department for Work and Pensions back in 2018. The figures for his pension at that time are broadly correct. Civil servants are “responsible” for developing and implementing policy, but not for policy decisions themselves.

text: From 1 October 2025 any bank transfers over £800 between individuals will be blocked for 24 hours as part of new verification measures set up by banks and HMRC.

claimReview.title: No, bank transfers over £800 will not be ‘automatically’ frozen for 24 hours – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Banks can already freeze transactions for further verification, but HMRC confirmed these particular claims aren’t true.

text: Only 30% of the arrests on Saturday were “Unite the Kingdom” protesters, with 70% being counter-protesters.

claimReview.title: What do we know about the arrests at the ‘Unite The Kingdom’ march? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence that this is the case. The Met Police have said of the 24 arrested, 23 were believed to have been involved in the main protest, with one believed to have been involved in the counter-protest.

text: From 5 December the government is introducing a £500 “Christmas Decoration Tax”.

claimReview.title: No, the government isn’t introducing a £500 ‘Christmas Decoration Tax’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such policy is being introduced.

text: Keir Starmer said Hamas is entitled to apply for an embassy in London having been formally recognised by the UK as a state.

claimReview.title: Keir Starmer did not say Hamas is entitled to apply for an embassy in London – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Mr Starmer did not say this. While the UK did recognise Palestinian statehood in September, and said it was in the process of establishing diplomatic ties with the Palestinian Authority, Hamas is still proscribed as a terrorist organisation in the UK. Mr Starmer said Hamas could have no future role in governing a Palestinian state.

text: Labour has deported 35,000 people.

claimReview.title: Has Labour ‘deported’ 35,000 people? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: That’s not correct, according to the government’s own data. There were around 35,000 immigration returns in total in Labour’s first year, most of which were voluntary.

text: A screenshot shows the website ‘My Jewish Learning’ published a recipe for haggis, describing it as a traditional Israeli pudding.

claimReview.title: Website didn’t publish recipe for ‘Israeli haggis’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t real. The creator, an account on X, said it was made in 2023 as a joke and there is no record of such a recipe ever having been published on the website.

text: Footage shows a robotic dog patrolling the grounds of a migrant hotel.

claimReview.title: Footage does not show a robot dog ‘patrolling a migrant hotel’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The footage appears to show a robotic dog but it was filmed in the grounds of a building housing a religious group in Crewe.

text: Donald Trump called Republicans the “dumbest group of voters in the country”.

claimReview.title: Trump didn’t call Republicans ‘the dumbest’ voters – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This quote isn’t real. It’s often attributed to a People magazine interview from 1998, but the magazine says it has no record of publishing an exchange like this.

text: Boots is offering a discounted gift box for people over 50 if they fill out a survey.

claimReview.title: ‘Boots offer’ for over-50s isn’t affiliated with retailer – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Boots confirmed this is not a genuine offer from them.

text: Three cabinet ministers resigned following a speech about Sir Keir Starmer by Prince William.

claimReview.title: No, Prince William did not give a speech that prompted three cabinet ministers to resign – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not true. Prince William made no such speech and no cabinet ministers resigned shortly before this claim was made.

text: A video shows asylum seekers arriving at a beach in Dover via small boats.

claimReview.title: Viral video does not show migrants at the beach in Dover – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. The video doesn’t show a beach in Dover, but appears to be a popular beach in Goa, India.

text: A photo shows a young Keir Starmer with Jimmy Savile, decorating a Christmas tree.

claimReview.title: Faked photo of Keir Starmer and Jimmy Savile decorating a Christmas tree recirculates – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This photo has been edited to include Savile’s face. The original image shows Mr Starmer with an older woman, reportedly his grandmother.

text: The Guardian published an opinion article headlined “Labour’s inquiry into promiscuous children is just an Islamophobic witch hunt”.

claimReview.title: Fake ‘Grauniad’ grooming gangs column shared as if real on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The Guardian confirmed it has published no such article.

text: It’s been confirmed by the Metropolitan Police that of the 26 people arrested at the “Unite the Kingdom” protests only eight were involved in the march, and 18 of those arrested were counter-protesters.

claimReview.title: What do we know about the arrests at the ‘Unite The Kingdom’ march? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. The Metropolitan Police hasn’t said this—it’s said 24 people were arrested, of which 23 were believed to be people involved in the "Unite the Kingdom" protest, with one believed to have been involved in the counter-protest.

text: A clip of a car twisted around a tree shows the crash site of the recent accident in which footballers Diogo Jota and André Silva were killed on 3 July.

claimReview.title: Clip shared with claims it shows Diogo Jota’s crash predates accident – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This clip has been online since at least May 2025. It shows a different car and does not match genuine footage of the crash site.

text: The results of an IQ test allegedly taken by Donald Trump during his first year at New York Military Academy have been discovered in a former staff member’s home and show his IQ is 73.

claimReview.title: No evidence Donald Trump scored 73 on an IQ test – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence of such a discovery or that President Trump has an IQ score of 73.

text: A video shows a mass funeral in Kunar province, Afghanistan, following a recent earthquake.

claimReview.title: Video of mass funeral following Afghanistan earthquake is probably AI – Full Fact

text: NHS figures show one in 10 children in Reception are clinically obese.

claimReview.title: Ads for plain porridge oats have not been banned – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. About one in 15 children are clinically obese in the latest data. About one in 10 are either clinically obese or at risk of becoming so.

text: UK banks have introduced a limit on cash withdrawals for people aged over 65.

claimReview.title: False claims about cash withdrawal limits for pensioners circulate online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. The Financial Conduct Authority confirmed no such policy has been introduced.

text: Sunglasses cause cancer.

claimReview.title: No, there’s no evidence sunglasses cause cancer – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Experts say there’s no credible evidence to support this claim. The use of sunglasses is widely recommended, including by the NHS, to protect the eyes and the skin around them from the cancer-causing UV rays in sunlight.

claimReview.title: The claim that sunglasses cause cancer isn’t backed by evidence – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Experts say there’s no credible evidence to support this claim.

text: Stagecoach is offering six months free travel for £1 in locations across the UK.

claimReview.title: Facebook offers of six months ‘unlimited travel’ on Stagecoach buses are not genuine – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Stagecoach has confirmed this offer is not genuine.

text: A clip shows Russian warplanes destroyed in recent Ukrainian drone strikes.

claimReview.title: Social media clip supposedly of ‘destroyed Russian warplanes’ is very likely AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not genuine footage. The clip was very likely created using artificial intelligence.

text: From 25 June, 8.7 million permanent residents will not be able to leave or enter the United States under a new executive order passed by President Donald Trump.

claimReview.title: President Trump has not passed executive order explicitly stopping green card holders leaving or entering US – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. A proclamation passed by President Trump on 4 June restricted the entry of foreign nationals from a number of countries to the United States, but does not apply to lawful permanent residents of the US.

text: The government is cancelling post-study work visas from November 2025, meaning international graduates will have just 30 days to leave the UK after their course ends.

claimReview.title: The government isn’t cancelling all graduate visas – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no evidence the government is cancelling graduate visas. However, their standard length is being shortened to 18 months (down from two years) if the person applies on or after 1 January 2027.

text: An Israeli officer named Yukhal Yulita has been hauled in by Dutch police on allegations of war crimes in Rafah in southern Gaza.

claimReview.title: No Israeli officer has been arrested in the Netherlands for war crimes – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The Netherlands Public Prosecution Service confirmed no Israeli nationals had been arrested in connection with war crimes. The accompanying photo is from a 2016 Daily Mail article about nightlife in Newcastle.

text: Argos is “giving away” laptops to the over-40s for £4.95.

claimReview.title: No, Argos is not ‘giving away’ laptops to the over-40s – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Argos has confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: Labour has halved the number of hotels used to house asylum seekers.

claimReview.title: Labour hasn’t ‘halved’ the number of asylum hotels – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not correct. The number of hotels peaked at just over 400 in summer 2023, and as of last month stood at 210. But most of this fall came under the Conservatives—under Labour there has been a net reduction of three hotels, from 213 in July 2024.

text: The President of Toby Carvery has announced an offer for a free meal-for-two at the restaurant chain for those who ‘like’ a Facebook post.

claimReview.title: Thousands ‘like’ fake Toby Carvery offer on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. A spokesperson for Mitchells & Butlers, the company that owns Toby Carvery, confirmed this is not a real offer associated with the chain.

text: The Daily Mail published an article with the headline: “Government considers BANNING England flag from being displayed in public”.

claimReview.title: Fake Daily Mail article about government considering banning England flags circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The Daily Mail published no such article and the government also confirmed it has no plans to ban displaying the England flag in public.

text: All users of virtual private networks in the UK will now have to show ID to the providers.

claimReview.title: UK users do not have to provide ID to use VPNs – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t correct. The Online Safety Act means some websites, such as those publishing pornography, must carry out age checks, but VPN providers do not fall under these requirements. The screenshot of the article included with the post does not state that this is happening.

text: Nationwide curfews (either 10pm or 11pm) are being introduced under a new law by the UK government which bans being out of your house at night. Breaking the curfews could lead to a fine or arrest.

claimReview.title: A nighttime curfew is not being introduced in the UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such curfew is being introduced.

text: John Lewis is selling Doona car seat strollers for less than £10 to people who fill in a survey.

claimReview.title: John Lewis is not selling car seat strollers for £3 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This is not a genuine John Lewis offer.

text: A video shows Pope Leo XIV addressing a speech to Burkina Faso's military ruler Captain Ibrahim Traoré.

claimReview.title: Clip of Pope Leo XIV addressing Burkina Faso leader is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This clip has been edited and likely includes deepfake audio of the Pope. He hasn’t delivered such a speech and the edited clip was first shared with a note saying it was a work of fiction.

text: A video shows a UK teacher telling children to do Islamic prayers and chant “Allahu Akbar”.

claimReview.title: Fake video of UK teacher telling children to bow and chant ‘Allahu Akbar’ circulates online – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video isn’t real and was almost certainly made using artificial intelligence.

text: An image shows Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro in custody being led away from a plane.

claimReview.title: Viral image of Nicolás Maduro being led away from plane isn’t real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image isn’t real. It was made using artificial intelligence.

text: An image shows a tree-lined road filled with protesters waving Union Jack flags.

claimReview.title: Image of crowd waving Union Jacks isn't from recent London protest and is almost certainly AI – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t a real photo. It has almost certainly been created with artificial intelligence (AI).

text: Under a new government policy starting 1 November, pensioners will have two days to withdraw their pensions once they are available. If they don’t, they will be fined or lose up to 20% of their money instantly.

claimReview.title: Video falsely claims pensions will have to be withdrawn within two days to avoid fines – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. There is no evidence of any such policy being introduced from 1 November.

text: JD Wetherspoon is offering “£2 for two” dinner vouchers to people who complete an online survey.

claimReview.title: Fake ‘£2 for two’ Wetherspoons offer shared on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. The account which shared this post is not associated with the pub chain and Wetherspoons has confirmed the offer is fake.

text: From 5 August UK residents will be legally restricted to just two units of essential grocery items per person.

claimReview.title: No, the government isn’t imposing restrictions on essential grocery items – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: A government spokesperson told us “this is completely false” and supermarkets Asda and Tesco also confirmed there are no such plans in place.

text: Israel killed Yemen’s Prime Minister.

claimReview.title: Yemen’s internationally-recognised Prime Minister has not been killed – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is missing context. Israel killed the Prime Minister of the Houthi rebel group, not Yemen’s internationally-recognised Prime Minister, who is still alive.

text: Rachel Reeves is going to tax privately owned homes a monthly window tax of £3.70 per window per house from August 2025.

claimReview.title: No evidence Rachel Reeves is introducing a ‘window tax’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We could find no evidence of any such tax being introduced in August. The Treasury has said there are no plans for a window tax and that the claim is “fake”.

text: Rotherham’s new mayor can’t speak English.

claimReview.title: New mayor of Rotherham can speak English, contrary to online claims – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is false. Mayor Rukhsana Ismail was born in Sheffield and can speak English fluently.

text: A video shows the crew boarding the Air India flight that crashed on 12 June.

claimReview.title: Video of an Air India crew boarding a plane was filmed days before the Ahmedabad crash – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video was posted on 9 June, three days before the crash.

text: A photo shows ‘Epping mums’ and their daughters.

claimReview.title: ‘Epping mums’ image is AI creation – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t a real picture. Uncropped versions have a watermark for ‘Grok’—the artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot integrated with X, which can create images from prompts.

text: A council in southern England has introduced a new rule which means anyone who sits for more than 15 minutes on a public bench could be fined £5.

claimReview.title: No evidence UK council will fine people £5 for sitting too long – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s absolutely no evidence this is happening anywhere in the UK.

text: A video the Metropolitan Police said was of a crowd at this month’s “Unite the Kingdom” rally on Whitehall in central London is actually footage from a 2020 anti-lockdown protest in Trafalgar Square.

claimReview.title: No, a Met Police video of the ‘Unite the Kingdom’ rally didn’t show a 2020 protest – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. The video that the police shared was taken on 13 September 2025, not in 2020. It shows the junction of Whitehall and Horse Guards Avenue, not Trafalgar Square.

text: A photo shows Angela Merkel, Theresa May and Ursula von der Leyen together as teenagers.

claimReview.title: Picture doesn’t show Theresa May, Ursula von der Leyen and Angela Merkel together as teenagers – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Mrs Merkel is in the photograph, but the other two people are not Baroness May or Ms von der Leyen.

text: A picture shows a newborn baby recently found abandoned in a dumpster in the UK.

claimReview.title: Images of a newborn found ‘abandoned in a dumpster’ were not taken in the UK – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is a hoax. These images were not taken in the UK and are not recent.

text: A video showing the Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer visiting a home in Staffordshire was staged, with an actress called Abby Raworth playing a mother-of-three named Nicola, and the kitchen the video was filmed in isn’t really Nicola’s kitchen.

claimReview.title: No, a video of the PM in a Staffordshire mum’s kitchen wasn’t staged with an actress – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These claims are false. The video does show the PM visiting the home of a woman called Nicola and it was filmed in her kitchen, as were other clips the same day.  A different woman named Abby Raworth works for a men’s hair stylist talent agency and does not appear in the clip.

text: mRNA vaccines fail to protect effectively against upper respiratory infections like Covid and flu.

claimReview.title: Robert F Kennedy Jr wrong about mRNA vaccines’ effectiveness – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not correct—mRNA vaccines have been proven to be effective against Covid-19. No mRNA flu vaccines have been approved yet, but one was more effective than standard flu vaccines in a recent trial.

text: We’ve seen inflation coming down.

claimReview.title: School standards minister confuses interest rates and inflation in Sky News interview – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Inflation has increased since Labour came into government in July 2024, and was also higher last month compared to the previous month.

text: A young boy was recently found abandoned by the roadside in various locations in the UK.

claimReview.title: Facebook reports of a young boy abandoned in Lancashire and West Yorkshire are hoaxes – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These posts appear to be hoaxes. The local police forces for the areas mentioned don’t recognise the incident.

text: A video of a lockdown drill in a UK school is being shared with an implication it shows “what they're making children do in schools in 2025”.

claimReview.title: UK school lockdown drill video is from 2017, not 2025 – Full Fact

text: A video shows an “illegal migrant” in the UK losing his temper after a store that “gives illegal migrants free PlayStation 5s on behalf of Oxford City Council” ran out of consoles.

claimReview.title: Video does not show man raging because ‘store that gives illegal migrants free PS5s ran out’ – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t true. While we can’t verify the immigration status of the man in the footage, the video was filmed in the US, not the UK and dates back to 2018. It has nothing to do with free PlayStations, and Oxford City Council says it runs no such scheme.

text: For Toby Carvery’s birthday the chain is giving away a free carvery for two to everyone who likes and comments “roast” on a Facebook post.

claimReview.title: Toby Carvery isn’t giving away a free meal for two to those who like a Facebook post – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not a genuine offer from the restaurant chain.

text: A video shows US special forces landing in Caracas, Venezuela.

claimReview.title: Old video of US military exercise shared with claims it shows soldiers landing in Venezuela – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This video is actually from June 2025 and shows a US military exercise in North Carolina.

text: A video shows Pakistan shooting down an Indian Air Force Rafale fighter jet near Bahawalpur in Pakistan.

claimReview.title: Clip of fighter jet being shot down is from video game not India-Pakistan conflict – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t what the video shows. It is actually gameplay footage from the military simulation game Arma 3.

text: A leading oncologist thinks it’s highly likely that the Covid vaccines have been a significant factor in the cancer of members of the Royal Family.

claimReview.title: Covid vaccine claims at the Reform UK conference: fact checked – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no credible evidence of a link between the Covid vaccines and cancer, and no evidence they were a factor in cancer cases within the Royal Family.

text: We’ve got record deportations.

claimReview.title: Has Labour carried out ‘record deportations’? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We can’t find evidence for this. Most immigration returns over the past year weren’t technically deportations, and neither the total number of returns nor the number of enforced returns during Labour’s first year in office represents a record over a 12-month period.

text: People who are alone and suspect they are having a heart attack should cough repeatedly and very strongly.

claimReview.title: Coughing hard won’t save you from a heart attack if you’re alone – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. This isn’t recommended medical advice to treat a heart attack. If someone suspects they’re having a heart attack they should call 999 immediately.

text: One in six Scots are on a waiting list for NHS care.

claimReview.title: Are one in six Scots waiting for NHS care? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is unreliable. The latest estimates from Public Health Scotland suggest one in nine Scots—or 618,477 people—were on a waiting list as of October 2025.

text: Gregg Wallace presented a documentary about a company producing lab-grown human flesh to process into steaks, sausages and burgers.

claimReview.title: Gregg Wallace’s satirical doc on ‘edible human meat’ shared as real – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This was a satirical programme released in 2023.

text: A video shows Captain Ibrahim Traoré, the military leader of Burkina Faso, making a long speech which criticises the portrayal of Africa in western media.

claimReview.title: Footage showing Burkina Faso leader is likely deepfake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Experts have told us this video is likely an AI deepfake, and Full Fact has found it has been potentially made using a real image of the African leader.

text: A picture shows Donald Trump with his daughter Ivanka when she was a child, and Jeffrey Epstein.

claimReview.title: Edited image of Donald and Ivanka Trump with Jeffrey Epstein circulates again – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This image has been manipulated, and is actually a composite of two photographs taken a decade apart.

text: Sir Keir Starmer has legalised marriage between brothers and sisters or parents and their children.

claimReview.title: No, the government hasn’t legalised marriage between brothers and sisters and parents and children – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. Marriage between close relatives is illegal in the UK.

text: To mark 40 years of Toby Carvery, free roasts are being offered to people who comment “Carvery” on Facebook posts.

claimReview.title: Fake Toby Carvery offers circulate on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: A spokesperson for Mitchells & Butlers, the company that owns Toby Carvery, confirmed these are not genuine offers associated with the chain.

text: A video shows Donald Trump criticising Sir Keir Starmer’s leadership and saying he’s “too busy worrying about everyone else’s problems”.

claimReview.title: Fake video of Donald Trump criticising Keir Starmer’s leadership is AI-generated – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There is no evidence Donald Trump said this. The audio in this clip is not authentic and was generated using AI.

text: Shein is giving away boxes of clothes to people who fill out an online form.

claimReview.title: Fake Shein offers circulate on social media – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is not true. The online form is not associated with the official Shein website.

text: A video shows Iranian missiles launched against Israel in retaliation for Israel’s attack on 13 June 2025.

claimReview.title: Old video shared with claims it shows Iran retaliating against Israel – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This footage is old and dates back to October 2024, although does appear to show Iranian missiles targeting Israel.

text: French President Emmanuel Macron said: “If we leave African countries to manage on their own, now is not the time. Africa remains the least developed continent, and history shows we have a role to play in supporting its growth. A complete withdrawal could halt progress."

claimReview.title: No evidence President Macron said Africa not ‘ready to thrive’ without French involvement – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: There’s no evidence that President Macron ever made these comments, and the French Embassy in the UK has told us the quote is “completely false”.

text: A video shows a “massive earthquake” triggering a tsunami which took “thousands of lives”.

claimReview.title: Video circulating amid Pacific tsunami evacuations is from 2017 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This video shows a tsunami caused by a landslide in Greenland in 2017, which killed four people. It is not linked to the current tsunami warnings following an earthquake off Russia.

text: Giving children vitamin A doses “can prevent and treat the measles”.

claimReview.title: Can vitamin A ‘prevent and treat’ measles? – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. Experts say that vitamin A cannot prevent measles infection, and that vaccination is the most effective way to prevent measles. However, in some cases vitamin A doses may be given to patients with measles to prevent or reduce some complications of the disease.

text: Keir Starmer has announced a policy limiting UK citizens to two flights per year from October 2025.

claimReview.title: ‘PM announcement’ of two flight limit is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. No such policy has been announced, and the social media videos claiming this feature inauthentic audio with old footage of Mr Starmer.

text: A compilation video shows various clips of China delivering aid to Gaza via air drops in May 2025.

claimReview.title: Video clips do not show China airdropping aid into Gaza during recent Israel aid blockade – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t what the first two videos of the compilation show. The first has been circulating online since at least April 2024, and a still image which matches the second is also from April 2024. We’ve not been able to trace the final two videos of the compilation but there are no credible reports that China has delivered aid by air, although it did arrange for aid to be delivered via land in February of this year.

text: There was no autism in Vietnam before 2001.

claimReview.title: Vaccines have not caused a rise in autism in Vietnam – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We can find no evidence to support this. Autism exists worldwide, but it was not recognised in Vietnam until the late 1990s. Some Vietnamese people born in the 20th century have autism.

text: A video shows Piera Mosque in Barcelona being burnt down.

claimReview.title: Old video of mosque fire in Indonesia shared as recent incident in Barcelona – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This clip actually shows a mosque fire in Jakarta, Indonesia, in 2022. However, there was a fire at an unopened mosque in Piera, near Barcelona, the cause of which is being investigated.

text: The chair of the BMA told Dr Malhotra in December 2021 that most of his colleagues got their information on the Covid vaccine from the BBC.

claimReview.title: Covid vaccine claims at the Reform UK conference: fact checked – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: We can’t say how accurate this claim is, as we have no way of directly verifying the exchange in 2021, but the chair of the BMA at the time has denied that he said this.

text: Aldi is giving away free food boxes worth £40 or £50 to people who engage with certain social media posts.

claimReview.title: Aldi is not giving away ‘free food boxes’ on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Aldi has confirmed this is not a genuine offer.

text: We welcomed around 900,000 newcomers from overseas, including 110,000 asylum seekers.

claimReview.title: Around 250,000 Brits emigrated last year, not 695,000 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t quite right. While estimated immigration was around 900,000 in the year to June 2025, only 96,000 are estimated to have arrived as asylum seekers. The 110,000 figure likely refers to the number of people who claimed asylum in the UK, not all of whom actually arrived in the country during this period.

text: The Amish refuse all vaccinations.

claimReview.title: Amish people do vaccinate - and autism exists in Amish communities – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: Incorrect. Although vaccine take up is much lower than the wider US population, research shows that many Amish people do receive some vaccinations.

text: Princess Anne has been recorded making a number of claims about Queen Camilla and saying she will be leaving her fortune and title for Princess Charlotte to inherit.

claimReview.title: Videos featuring deepfake audio of Princess Anne viewed millions of times on Facebook – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: These are deepfake audio clips where Princess Anne’s voice has been cloned. We could find no evidence of Princess Anne making any such comments.

text: A video showing explosions has been shared online with claims about recent US military strikes in the Port of Caracas and on Margarita Island in Venezuela.

claimReview.title: A video shared with claims about US military strikes on Venezuela actually dates from 2024 – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This is misleading. This footage dates back to October 2024 and was filmed in Israel, not Venezuela.

text: The UK has pledged £40 billion to rebuild Gaza.

claimReview.title: The UK has not pledged £40 billion for Gaza reconstruction – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: False. This appears to be an estimate of the total cost of reconstruction. There’s no evidence the UK has committed, or plans to commit, this amount.

text: A photograph shows Donald Trump, with his daughter Ivanka when she was little, and Jeffrey Epstein.

claimReview.title: Picture of Donald and Ivanka Trump with Jeffrey Epstein has been edited – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: This isn’t a genuine image. It is a doctored composite of two real photos taken more than ten years apart.

text: The government is introducing a new system called “enhanced customs monitoring” on 4 August. This will flag if UK residents leave the country more than three times within a 12 month period so their declared income, employment status and tax residency can be checked.

claimReview.title: Going abroad four times a year won’t flag you to HMRC for ‘enhanced customs monitoring’ from August – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: HMRC confirmed this isn’t true. No such system exists.

text: An image shows a hospital destroyed by Hurricane Melissa in Jamaica.

claimReview.title: Image shared with claims it shows Jamaican hospital destroyed by Hurricane Melissa is fake – Full Fact
claimReview.textualRating: The image is fake and was very likely made using AI. Real images of the hospital do not match the scene shared online.
